Title: Marketing Operations Manager
Description:
Deep Knowledge Group · MarTech Department · Reports to the Head of MarTech

**The role**
------------

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech websites and platforms. Today the website tracking, the application analytics, the CRM and the campaign reports each work on their own. You will connect them: set up tracking, run the analytics and CRM systems, and make sure enquiries and reports reach the people who act on them.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Tracking and measurement**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Web development: page templates, the scheduled checking worker and site fixes belong to a web engineer.
* Content and SEO writing, which belongs to the editor.
* Commercial follow-up, which BisDev owns. You build the routing and fields; they run the conversations.

**How you will work**
---------------------

You will work with the Head of MarTech, the web operations specialist (forms, publishing and web edits), the BisDev team, Front-end and Product. Tools include Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack and Google Workspace. Working hours are flexible, with overlap with UK time (our team works roughly 8:00–18:00 UK).

Title: CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
Description:
**Job Description**

**CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager – Middle East & Asia**

**Location:** Dubai

**Reports to:** Head of Growth Marketing Hub & Innovation – Middle East & Asia

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**

The **CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager** maximises the commercial effectiveness of CRM across 30+ schools in the Middle East, India and Asia, improving customer progression and conversion through effective lifecycle journeys, automation, segmentation, personalisation and continuous optimisation.

The role translates Group CRM strategy, lifecycle frameworks and platform capability into a **prioritised divisional CRM and lifecycle Marketing improvement roadmap**, using customer, funnel and market evidence to determine where intervention will have the greatest commercial impact.

Operating within Group-owned CRM strategy, architecture, governance, data standards and common lifecycle frameworks, the role leads the CRM Executive / Specialist and acts as the principal divisional interface with Group CRM / Technology. Admissions, Retention and school teams retain accountability for their respective customer processes and operational outcomes.

**ROLE IN THE OPERATING MODEL / SCOPE**

* **Owns CRM & lifecycle Marketing performance and optimisation across MEA.**
* **Enables rather than replaces business ownership of customer processes.**  
  Admissions, Retention and school teams retain ownership of customer processes and outcomes within their remit, including data capture, lead follow-up and customer intervention. CRM & Lifecycle Marketing improves these processes through journeys, automation, segmentation, communications and insight.
* **Leads a portfolio capability, not a school-by-school service desk.**  
  Leads the CRM Executive / Specialist, who provides configuration, execution, QA and reporting against agreed priorities. CRM resource is prioritised according to customer and commercial impact across the portfolio.
* **Manages divisional CRM demand within enterprise governance.**  
  Manages CRM demand, optimisation and delegated administration through the COE intake and prioritisation process. Routine activity is handled through standard capability, self-service or accountable business owners; requirements affecting enterprise CRM strategy, architecture, core workflows, integrations or standards are partnered with Group CRM / Technology.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **CRM Roadmap & Prioritisation**

Own the CRM improvement roadmap, using customer, funnel and CRM performance evidence to prioritise capability, adoption and optimisation interventions across 30+ schools according to commercial impact and customer need.

* **Portfolio CRM Performance & Journey Optimisation**

Monitor portfolio CRM performance, diagnose material conversion gaps and variation, and determine the appropriate CRM intervention.

Apply and continuously optimise Group-established lifecycle journeys and workflows through configuration, segmentation, messaging, timing, channel and automation within agreed standards.

* **Segmentation, Lead Scoring & Experimentation**

Apply and optimise segmentation and lead-scoring approaches within Group frameworks and lead the divisional CRM experimentation programme, using evidence from tests and conversion performance to improve CRM-controlled journeys and recommend enhancements where common capability should evolve.

* **Market Requirements & Group CRM Partnership**

Act as the interface with Group CRM / Technology, translating legitimate customer, commercial, regulatory and operational requirements into clear business requirements and jointly determining whether the response should be local configuration, controlled variation or enterprise capability change.

* **CRM Performance Insight & Business Enablement**

Translate CRM, journey, adoption and conversion data into clear priorities and recommendations for Regional Marketing Managers, Admissions, Retention and other business owners.Distinguish CRM issues from wider process, follow-up, proposition or Marketing issues so accountability remains with the appropriate owner.

* **CRM Governance, Data Quality & Controlled Administration**

Maintain disciplined CRM governance within delegated Group guardrails, including QA, documentation and change control. Establish scalable guidance and self-service capability, ensuring CRM demand is routed through agreed intake and prioritisation processes and that routine activity remains with the appropriate business owner.

* **New School Onboarding**

Lead CRM and lifecycle Marketing onboarding for new schools, including CRM data migration, configuration, permissions and adoption, working with Group CRM / Technology and relevant specialist owners to ensure continuity and compliance.

* **Team Leadership & Scalable Delivery Model**

Lead and develop the CRM Executive / Specialist, setting priorities, quality standards and clear delegation between Manager-level optimisation and execution. Build self-sufficiency among Regional Marketing Managers, Admissions, Retention and school users through guidance, training and Group-approved resources, routing routine activity to self-service or business ownership where appropriate.

* **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

Identify relevant opportunities in automation, personalisation, AI, channel integration and CRM practice; test improvements within agreed guardrails and feed evidence back to Group so successful divisional learning can inform wider enterprise capability.

**FUNCTIONAL CAPABILITIES REQUIRED**

* **Lifecycle Marketing & Conversion Optimisation**

Strong expertise in applying and improving lifecycle journeys, diagnosing funnel leakage and optimising CRM-controlled progression within enterprise frameworks.

* **Marketing Automation & CRM Platforms**

Strong hands-on capability with HubSpot or comparable enterprise CRM / automation platforms, including workflows, segmentation, forms, email, reporting and controlled administration.

* **Segmentation, Personalisation & Lead Scoring**

Ability to apply and optimise segmentation, scoring and personalisation approaches that improve relevance, prioritisation and conversion.

* **CRM Roadmapping, Governance & Process Improvement**

Ability to translate enterprise CRM strategy into a prioritised divisional roadmap, improve processes within defined decision rights and avoid competing standards or architectures.

* **CRM Analytics, Testing & Performance Insight**

Ability to analyse journey and conversion performance, define useful CRM measures and reporting requirements, and run structured experimentation that produces actionable learning.

* **CRM Data, Integrations & Technical Fluency**

Working understanding of CRM data structures, data quality, website/form capture, messaging tools, BI, APIs and integrations sufficient to define requirements and work effectively with enterprise technical owners.

* **Multi-Channel Lifecycle Communications**

Strong understanding of lifecycle communication across approved channels, including sequencing, frequency, personalisation, deliverability and quality assurance of conversion-focused content and templates.

**LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES REQUIRED**

* **Commercial & Conversion Judgement**

Prioritises CRM activity according to customer value, enrolment progression and measurable business impact rather than engagement metrics alone

* **Systems & Journey Thinking**

Understands the dependencies between customer journeys, technology, data, communications and human follow-up and favours scalable solutions over isolated campaigns.

* **Analytical Problem Solving**

Diagnoses conversion and process issues, tests hypotheses and distinguishes CRM problems from wider Marketing, Admissions, Retention or technology issues.

* **Prioritisation & Stakeholder Influence**

Makes clear trade-offs across competing market requirements and aligns business and Group stakeholders around journey, process and platform improvements.

* **People Leadership & Accountability**

Sets clear expectations, delegates appropriately, develops the CRM Executive / Specialist and maintains high standards of accuracy and ownership in reputation- and customer-sensitive CRM activity.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. This role leads the day-to-day development and delivery of integrated communications for national brand, product and promotional campaigns. The successful candidate will work closely with category, media, digital and loyalty, public relations, operations, field teams, franchisees and agency partners. Title: Senior Procurement Manager
Description:
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Senior Procurement Manager leads strategic aspects within key Indirect Categories such as IT, Logistics, Marketing, and Human Capital across divisions on a global level. The purpose of the role is to develop and maintain organizational structures and necessary alignments to ensure an effective procurement process while providing high-value external solutions to support business projects in Saudi Arabia. This position acts as the primary procurement business partner for Business Units in KSA, ensuring alignment with budgets, strategy, productivity, and margin expansion initiatives. Success in this role involves designing and delivering comprehensive procurement strategies, fostering relationships with stakeholders, and maintaining operational compliance and governance.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Business Engagement & Demand Forecasting**

  
  

* Develop a deep understanding of business unit strategies, operational plans, and upcoming requirements across all KSA divisions.
* Lead structured demand planning and forecasting cycles to ensure accurate visibility of procurement needs.
* Maintain a rolling procurement pipeline for KSA, updated monthly and shared with regional category and sourcing teams.
* Facilitate early engagement between stakeholders and procurement to ensure timely planning and alignment with category strategies.
  

  

#### **Compliance, Governance & Policy Adherence**

  
  

* Ensure all procurement activities within KSA adhere to corporate policies, procedures, and delegated authority frameworks.
* Monitor compliance levels across business units and implement corrective actions where gaps are identified.
* Conduct periodic training and awareness sessions for local stakeholders on procurement processes, systems, and compliance expectations.
* Support internal and external audit requirements by providing documentation, clarifications, and process insights.
  

  

#### **Coordination with Regional Category & Sourcing Teams**

  
  

* Act as the primary interface between KSA stakeholders and category/sourcing teams based in UAE and Egypt.
* Translate business needs into clear category briefs and sourcing requests to enable efficient remote support.
* Track progress of sourcing activities and ensure timely delivery of outcomes (RFPs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, contracts).
* Escalate bottlenecks or misalignments and drive resolution to maintain service levels.
  

  

#### **Procurement Planning & Execution Support**

  
  

* Support the execution of sourcing events, supplier onboarding, and contract finalization in coordination with regional teams.
* Ensure procurement requests (PRs) are complete, accurate, and aligned with approved budgets and category strategies.
* Monitor contract lifecycle milestones and support renewals, amendments, and performance reviews.
  

  

#### **Stakeholder Relationship Management**

  
  

* Build strong, trust-based relationships with business leaders, project managers, finance, and operations teams across KSA.
* Provide proactive guidance on procurement timelines, market insights, and sourcing options.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to stakeholders, helping them optimize cost, quality, and risk outcomes.
  

  

#### **Supplier Performance & Issue Resolution**

  
  

* Support supplier performance monitoring by gathering feedback from KSA stakeholders and sharing insights with category managers.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier issues, disputes, or service failures in collaboration with regional teams.
* Contribute to supplier review meetings and ensure local performance data is captured and acted upon.
  

  

#### **Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

  
  

* Deliver regular reporting on procurement pipeline, compliance metrics, sourcing progress, and savings achievements for KSA.
* Identify opportunities to streamline local procurement processes and enhance stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to regional procurement improvement initiatives and support implementation within KSA.
  

  

#### **Local Market & Regulatory Awareness**

  
  

* Maintain awareness of KSA-specific regulatory requirements, local content rules, and market dynamics.
* Ensure procurement activities reflect local legal and compliance obligations.
* Provide insights to category teams to help shape regional strategies with KSA-specific considerations.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and financial modeling tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to execute projects successfully and deliver external solutions timely, within budget, and meeting quality standards.
* Understanding of Procurement KPIs related to market insights, price and demand development, and performance metrics.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* University/Advanced degree needed.
* Master's Degree or other advanced degree preferred.
* CIPS (or equivalent) qualification.
* 10+ years of relevant business experience, preferably in Procurement, Automotive, Retail, or Real Estate industries.
* Experience in Procurement, category management, supplier management, or related areas with a focus on Indirect Categories.

**About SIS Pitches**

SIS Pitches is a leading international provider of sports surfaces, delivering world-class football, rugby, hockey, cricket, and multi-sport facilities across global markets. Our expertise spans the complete project lifecycle, including design, manufacturing, construction, surfacing, installation, and long-term maintenance of natural, hybrid, and synthetic turf systems.

As we continue to expand internationally, we are seeking a highly experienced Procurement Manager to lead our global sourcing and procurement activities, ensuring the highest quality materials and services are secured at the most competitive commercial terms.

**Position Summary**

The Procurement Manager is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing procurement strategies that support SIS Pitches' global operations. The role requires exceptional negotiation skills, commercial acumen, supplier management expertise, and a strong focus on cost optimization without compromising quality, performance, safety, or project timelines.

The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing and securing the best-value products, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and services from international markets while building strategic supplier relationships that contribute to the company's long-term success.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Procurement & Sourcing**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Source high-quality materials, products, equipment, and services for sports pitch construction and maintenance projects in Saudi Arabia.
* Identify and evaluate new suppliers, manufacturers, and strategic partners globally.
* Continuously assess market conditions, industry developments, and pricing trends to maximize procurement efficiencies.
* Establish and maintain approved supplier frameworks and preferred vendor agreements.

**Supplier Management**

* Build and manage strong relationships with key suppliers and manufacturers.
* Conduct supplier performance evaluations covering quality, pricing, delivery performance, sustainability, and reliability.
* Negotiate long-term supply agreements that secure favourable commercial terms and mitigate supply chain risks.
* Lead supplier audits and due diligence processes where required.

**Contract Negotiation**

* Lead high-value procurement negotiations for materials, equipment, logistics, and subcontracted services.
* Secure the best combination of cost, quality, warranty, service support, and delivery schedules.
* Review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts and commercial agreements.
* Ensure all contracts comply with company policies and legal requirements.

**Cost Management & Value Engineering**

* Deliver measurable cost savings across all procurement categories.
* Drive value engineering initiatives to improve product performance while reducing overall project costs.
* Analyse total cost of ownership rather than simply focusing on purchase price.
* Prepare procurement budgets and cost forecasts for major projects.

**Supply Chain Management**

* Manage procurement schedules in line with project delivery requirements.
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks and disruptions.
* Ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment to project sites.
* Work closely with logistics providers to optimize transportation and storage costs.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Teams, Design Teams, Finance, and Senior Leadership.
* Provide procurement expertise during project planning and tender stages.
* Support bid preparation by obtaining competitive pricing and supplier commitments.
* Assist project teams in resolving procurement and supply-related issues.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure ethical procurement practices are maintained across all regions.
* Maintain accurate procurement records and reporting systems.
* Ensure suppliers comply with company standards relating to quality, health and safety, environmental compliance, and sustainability.
* Implement procurement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the procurement function across the business.
* Mentor and support procurement and supply chain personnel.
* Establish procurement KPIs and performance metrics.
* Prepare and present procurement reports to senior management.
* Drive a culture of commercial excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 10 years' procurement experience, with at least 5 years in a senior procurement role.
* Experience within construction, sports infrastructure, civil engineering, manufacturing, or related industries.
* Proven ability to negotiate significant cost savings without compromising quality.
* Strong commercial, analytical, and contract management skills.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Essential**

* Outstanding negotiation and influencing skills.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.
* Ability to consistently source high-quality products at the most competitive prices.
* Excellent contract management and procurement knowledge.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strategic thinker with excellent decision-making ability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to perform under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

**Preferred**

* Experience procuring sports turf systems, construction materials, irrigation systems, sports lighting, equipment, or specialist infrastructure products.
* Experience working across international markets.
* Knowledge of procurement software and ERP systems.

**Job Summary**

Client is looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Retail Operations Manager** to oversee the operations and business performance of all Client's retail stores.

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, improving store profitability, managing inventory, overseeing buying and merchandising activities, developing supplier relationships and ensuring an excellent customer experience across all locations.

This role requires a hands-on retail leader with strong commercial awareness, analytical skills and the ability to lead teams, identify business opportunities and translate performance insights into practical actions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Retail Operations & Sales Management**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of all Client's stores, ensuring consistent operational standards and efficient store management.

* Review daily, weekly and monthly sales results, identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Conduct regular store visits to monitor operational standards, customer service, sales performance and overall store execution.
* Ensure stores maintain attractive layouts, effective product displays, proper visual merchandising and a positive shopping environment.
* Identify opportunities to improve store productivity, sales conversion and customer experience.

**2. Inventory, Merchandising & Buying**

* Oversee stock management across all stores, ensuring optimal inventory levels and product availability.
* Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving and ageing stock and implement appropriate actions to improve stock turnover and sell-through.
* Plan replenishment and stock transfers between stores based on sales trends, inventory levels and customer demand.
* Oversee product buying and ordering activities, ensuring purchasing decisions are aligned with sales forecasts, market demand and business objectives.
* Analyze product and category performance to identify buying opportunities, reduce excess inventory and improve stock investment.
* Identify new products, brands and emerging toy trends to strengthen the company's product range and drive additional sales.
* Ensure new products and brands are effectively introduced, displayed and promoted across stores.

**3. Supplier & Market Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, brand principals and product representatives.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, payment terms, promotional support and other commercial arrangements to improve profitability.
* Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries, product availability and supplier-related issues.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, product offerings and pricing through regular market visits and industry engagement.
* Identify new suppliers, brands and business opportunities that can enhance the company's product portfolio and competitive position.

**4. Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Monitor sales, gross margins and overall profitability across all Client's stores.
* Review store and business P&L performance, identify key financial drivers and take action to address underperformance.
* Improve gross margins through effective buying, supplier negotiations, product selection and pricing strategies.
* Monitor discounts, promotions and promotional activities to drive sales while protecting profitability.
* Identify opportunities to control operating expenses, improve operational efficiency and maximize store profitability.
* Ensure effective stock investment and inventory turnover to support healthy cash flow and business returns.

**5. Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers, Supervisors and retail teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Monitor individual and store team performance, providing regular feedback, guidance and support.
* Improve team capabilities through training in product knowledge, selling techniques, customer service and store operations.
* Ensure clear communication of targets, responsibilities and operational expectations across all stores.
* Address performance gaps and operational challenges in coordination with Human Resources and relevant departments.

**6. Business Development & Reporting**

* Identify and recommend opportunities to improve store performance, expand product categories and enhance the customer experience.
* Oversee store improvement, renovation and development initiatives in coordination with relevant departments.
* Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain and Human Resources to ensure effective retail operations.
* Prepare regular management reports covering sales, profitability, inventory, buying, supplier performance, store operations and key business opportunities.
* Present business insights and recommendations to senior management to support commercial and operational decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in retail management, sales operations, merchandising, buying or multi-store operations.
* ***Experience in managing multiple retail locations, preferably in toys, children's products, specialty retail*** or a similar consumer retail environment.
* Proven ability to manage sales targets, inventory, customer experience and store profitability.
* Strong understanding of retail buying, merchandising, stock management, supplier relations and commercial negotiations.
* Experience reviewing sales reports, gross margins, stock movement and P&L performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Commercially minded, results-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.

Performance will be evaluated based on the following key areas:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and overall retail growth.
* **Profitability:** Gross margin improvement, P&L performance and operating cost control.
* **Inventory Management:** Stock turnover, sell-through, product availability and ageing stock reduction.
* **Buying & Merchandising:** Effective purchasing decisions, product range development and supplier performance.
* **Operational Excellence:** Store standards, customer experience and operational efficiency.

Title: Senior Health and Safety Manager
Description:
At Mace, our purpose is to redefine the boundaries of ambition. We believe in creating places that are responsible, bringing transformative impact to our people, communities, and societies across the globe. To learn more about our purpose, culture, and priorities, visit our strategy site.

Within our consult business we harness our unique combination of leading-edge practical expertise and project delivery consultancy to unlock the potential in every project.

* Provide visible executive leadership for health, safety, and wellbeing across the program and model Mace’s Safety First value.
* Set and maintain program health and safety strategy, policy, standards, governance, delegated authorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective control of critical risks including excavation, shafts, temporary works, lifting, work at height, confined spaces, mobile plant, electrical systems, fire, track access, and simultaneous operations.
* Lead health and safety input into design, constructability, logistics, procurement, construction sequencing, energization, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Chair executive safety governance and critical-risk reviews, ensuring decisions are evidence-based and actions are owned and closed.
* Exercise authority to stop or defer work where risk is unacceptable, controls are ineffective, or legal and project requirements are not met.
* Promote occupational health, mental health, fatigue management, exposure control, ergonomics, inclusion, and workforce wellbeing.
* Act as the client’s principal health and safety adviser and provide clear recommendations to the program executive and governance bodies.
* Develop and govern the program health and safety management system, assurance plan, critical-risk framework, audit regime, and reporting model.
* Ensure constructors, contractors, designers, and suppliers discharge their legal, contractual, and project health and safety obligations.
* Lead risk-based assurance across stations, shafts, underground works, compounds, rail systems, testing and commissioning, and operational interfaces.
* Own executive reporting on leading and lagging indicators, high-potential events, critical controls, occupational health, regulatory matters, and contractor performance.
* Lead strategic engagement with Ontario regulators, emergency services, joint health and safety committees, workforce representatives, and independent assurance providers.
* Provide health and safety leadership through major transitions including mobilization, excavation, structural completion, fit-out, permanent power, dynamic testing, trial operations, and handover.
* Sponsor serious incident investigations and learning reviews, ensuring systemic causes are addressed and improvements are verified across the program.
* Provide independent, evidence-based advice where schedule, cost, production, or stakeholder pressure conflicts with safe delivery.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, hazards, occupational illnesses, and regulatory interactions are reported and governed transparently.
* Maintain auditable records and ensure executive decisions, acceptance of risk, exemptions, and corrective actions are documented appropriately.
* Challenge normalization of deviance, weak supervision, under-reporting, recurring deficiencies, and superficial close-out.
* Escalate significant legal, safety, reputational, or operational risks promptly with clear options and recommendations.
* Protect workers’ rights and confidentiality while meeting legal, contractual, and governance obligations.
* Lead, structure, and develop the program health and safety function, including senior managers, managers, advisers, inspectors, occupational health resources, and specialist support.
* Establish clear functional accountabilities, competency requirements, succession plans, resource forecasts, and performance expectations.
* Coach program executives, project directors, construction leaders, and contractor leadership to integrate risk control into business and delivery decisions.
* Promote worker engagement, learning teams, joint inspections, critical-control verification, and effective joint health and safety committees.

**You’ll Need To Have:**

* Proven Director-level or head-of-function health and safety leadership experience on major subway, metro, railway, underground, or similarly complex infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated accountability for multiple contractors, projects, stations, or work packages within a major program environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of underground station construction, deep excavations, shafts, temporary works, lifting, confined spaces, utilities, MEP, rail systems, and commissioning interfaces.
* Thorough knowledge of Ontario occupational health and safety requirements, constructor duties, employer responsibilities, worker rights, and joint health and safety committees.
* Experience designing and governing health and safety management systems, critical-risk frameworks, assurance programs, and executive performance reporting.
* Experience leading serious incident investigations and organizational learning across major projects.
* Ability to influence program executives, clients, contractors, designers, regulators, and workforce representatives.
* Strong executive communication, governance, negotiation, decision-making, coaching, and crisis-management capability.
* A record of improving culture, leading indicators, critical-control effectiveness, contractor accountability, and occupational health outcomes.
* A degree or recognized qualification in occupational health and safety, engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.
* A Canadian Registered Safety Professional designation, Canadian Health and Safety Consultant designation, National Construction Safety Officer designation, or equivalent professional credential is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience, including substantial Director-level or head-of-function responsibility on major infrastructure programs.
* Experience with ISO 45001-aligned management systems, risk-based assurance, human factors, organizational learning, and critical-control management.
* Formal training in incident investigation, auditing, emergency management, occupational hygiene, or behavioural and human factors approaches is advantageous.
* Experience in operational rail environments, underground works, brownfield interfaces, or transit commissioning is strongly preferred.
* A visible, credible, authoritative, and solutions-focused executive leadership style with the confidence to challenge decisions at any level.
* Eligibility to work in Canada and willingness to work across project offices, stations, shafts, tunnels, compounds, and operational environments in the Greater Toronto Area.

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel:** We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

**Note:** The estimated salary for this position is 130,000 - 180,000 CAD. Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills and qualifications.

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organization.

We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role.

Title: Head of Sales
Description:
**About Us**

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

**The Opportunity**

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead and develop the sales team**

* Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
* Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
* Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
* Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

**Own pipeline, forecast and results**

* Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
* Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
* Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
* Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

**Build the sales engine**

* Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
* Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
* Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
* Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
* Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

**Partner across the business**

* Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
* Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
* Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
* Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
* Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
* A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
* Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
* Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
* A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
* Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
* The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope at the right moment.** You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
* **Expertise that scales.** Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
* **Own the outcomes.** We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
* **Do the right thing.** We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.

* **A remote team that stays connected.** We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
* **Momentum you can sell.** A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.

* **Variable compensation:** On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
* **Benefits:** Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment

The successful candidate will be responsible for building a scalable partner ecosystem, driving adoption of Versa's networking and cybersecurity solutions, and generating sustainable recurring revenue through partner-led go-to-market strategies.

This position requires an entrepreneurial, hands-on sales leader with strong executive relationship skills, deep knowledge of the Canadian telecommunications and managed services landscape, and a demonstrated track record of developing new business.

The role is remote and must be based in Eastern Canada, preferably within Ontario or Quebec, to facilitate engagement with strategic partners and their leadership teams

### **Responsibilities**

Strategic Service Provider Account Development

Title: Sales Manager - Tashkeel
Description:
**Sales Manager Tashkeel**

**Department**: Sales & Business Development  
**Reporting to**: Director of Operations & Commercial Strategy and General Manager  
**Working with**: Marketing Manager, Art Consultant, Design Consultant, Business Development Manager, Workshop Team, Graphic Design & Branding Team, and Accounts Team  
**Location**: Tashkeel, Nad Al Sheba 1, Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type**: Full-time  
**Salary Range** : AED 15,000 - 18,000 per month + sales commission per quarter  
**Start Date**: January 2027

**About Tashkeel**

Established in 2008, Tashkeel is a Dubai-based art and design studio and consultancy supporting creative practice, professional development, and the growth of the UAE's art and design industries.

Tashkeel operates across education and outreach, workshops, exhibitions, artist and designer mentorship programmes, retail, and commercial creative services.

Its professional development initiatives include the Tanween Design Programme, Critical Practice Programme (CPP), and Art & Design Residencies.

Through its commercial consultancy, Tasmeem Tashkeel, the organisation provides bespoke art and design commissions, graphic design and branding, interior and spatial design, furniture and product development, manufacturing, corporate and VIP gifting, public art, and complete turnkey solutions for corporate, government, hospitality, and private clients.

**Position Overview**

Tashkeel is seeking an experienced, results-driven Sales Manager responsible for generating new business, securing contracts, expanding commercial partnerships, and achieving revenue targets across Tashkeel and Tasmeem Tashkeel.

The role requires a strong B2B sales professional capable of selling educational programmes, corporate workshops, wholesale products, artwork, branding, bespoke design services, and large-scale commercial commissions.

A key responsibility is identifying opportunities to cross-sell services across departments, transforming individual client requirements into larger, integrated turnkey projects.

The Sales Manager will work closely with internal specialists to develop commercially viable proposals, while maintaining direct responsibility for client acquisition, negotiations, sales conversion, and revenue growth.

This is strictly a sales position, not a marketing or creative management role.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Workshops, Courses & Educational Programme Sales**

* Work closely with the Workshop and Education & Outreach teams to increase enrolment and sales for weekend drop-in workshops, structured courses, seasonal programmes, and creative learning activities at Tashkeel.
* Secure contracts with schools for after-school workshops, term-based programmes, and recurring educational activities.
* Develop and sell corporate team-building workshops, employee engagement experiences, and creative development programmes to commercial and government entities.
* Establish annual and recurring workshop contracts with companies, schools, universities, and institutions.
* Understand Tashkeel's mentorship and professional development programmes, including Tanween and CPP, to identify suitable commercial partnerships and institutional opportunities.
* Coordinate workshop proposals, pricing, capacity, and scheduling with the Workshop team and Accounts department.

**2. Tasmeem Tashkeel Commercial Sales**

* Generate new business for bespoke design, product development, manufacturing, furniture, lighting, interior design, corporate and VIP gifting, public art, and turnkey commissions.
* Target developers, hospitality groups, architects, interior designers, luxury brands, government entities, corporate clients, and private collectors.
* Work closely with the Art Consultant on artwork sales, art commissions, public art, and art consultancy projects.
* Work closely with the Design Consultant on interior design, furniture, spatial design, and bespoke product commissions.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, long-term commercial relationships, and larger project contracts.
* Coordinate with the relevant consultants and production teams to establish project scope, feasibility, pricing, and delivery requirements.

**3. Graphic Design, Branding & Integrated Turnkey Sales**

* Actively acquire clients for Tashkeel's graphic design and branding team, securing commissions for brand identity, visual communication, packaging, branded collateral, and complete branding projects.
* Target new businesses, hospitality operators, developers, retailers, corporate organisations, and established brands seeking new identities or rebranding services.
* Work with the Graphic Design & Branding Team to develop client briefs, proposals, and commercial quotations.
* Identify opportunities to expand branding commissions into interior design, signage, furniture, product design, packaging, and bespoke manufacturing.
* Collaborate across the branding, interior design, product design, and production teams to present integrated turnkey solutions to clients.
* Maximise the commercial value of each client relationship by identifying additional services that can be delivered across Tasmeem Tashkeel's departments.

**4. Retail, Wholesale & Product Distribution**

* Identify and secure new wholesale clients, retail stockists, museum shops, concept stores, hotels, and design boutiques in the UAE and selected international markets.
* Manage relationships with existing wholesale clients, encouraging repeat orders and increased product placement.
* Negotiate wholesale agreements, minimum order quantities, pricing, and commercial terms.
* Identify opportunities for exclusive collections, bulk orders, seasonal products, and corporate gifting.
* Work with Retail, Production, and Accounts to ensure product availability, competitive pricing, and approved profit margins.
* Support revenue growth across Tashkeel's physical and online retail channels.

**5. Client Acquisition, Contracts & Sales Management**

* Proactively generate qualified leads through direct outreach, networking, client meetings, presentations, and industry events.
* Develop and maintain relationships with corporate clients, government entities, procurement departments, retailers, and private clients.
* Manage the full sales cycle from initial enquiry and client presentation through quotation, negotiation, and signed contract.
* Work with the in-house Accounts team to calculate sales prices, project costs, gross profit margins, and financial forecasts.
* Ensure all proposals and quotations are commercially approved before submission and that no consultancy or design work begins without an agreed scope and approved commercial terms.
* Coordinate with Project Managers and relevant departments to hand over confirmed projects for execution.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts, client follow-ups, and weekly pipeline reports.
* Work closely with the Marketing Manager to convert campaign-generated leads into confirmed sales, without responsibility for marketing or content production.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Sales Manager will be assessed against the following proposed performance targets, subject to management approval.

**Sales Revenue:** Achieve 100% or more of assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets

**Qualified Client Meetings**: 12–16 per month

**New Sales Opportunities** 10–15 qualified opportunities per month

**Sales Conversion** Convert 25–35% of qualified proposals into confirmed contracts

**Sales Pipeline** Maintain a qualified pipeline of at least 3 times the next quarter's sales target

**Corporate & Educational Contracts** Secure 4–8 new workshop, team-building, or educational contracts per quarter

**Workshop & Course Sales** Meet agreed monthly enrolment and booking revenue targets

**Tasmeem Commercial Contracts** Secure 1–3 new contracts per quarter, depending on project value

**Branding & Graphic Design Sales** Meet agreed quarterly contract and revenue targets

**Cross-Departmental Sales** Generate measurable additional revenue through integrated, multi-service projects

**Wholesale Expansion** Secure 2–3 new stockists or wholesale accounts per quarter

**Repeat Business** Generate at least 30% of annual revenue from returning clients and repeat orders

**Profitability & Collections** Meet approved gross profit margins and coordinate timely collection of payments

**CRM & Reporting** Maintain accurate weekly pipeline updates and monthly sales forecasts

Performance will be evaluated primarily on confirmed contracts, collected revenue, profitability, new client acquisition, and repeat business, rather than enquiries or meetings alone.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Business Development, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or commercial account management.
* Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets and securing high-value commercial contracts.
* Experience selling professional services, creative consultancy, branding, interior design, corporate solutions, bespoke products, or educational programmes.
* Strong understanding of client acquisition, pricing, negotiation, contract management, and sales forecasting.
* Experience working with corporate organisations, government entities, procurement teams, developers, and hospitality clients.
* Established professional network within the UAE commercial market is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in CRM systems and sales reporting.
* Fluent English required; Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a commercially focused B2B sales professional who can independently identify opportunities, approach decision-makers, negotiate contracts, and consistently close business.

They must understand how to sell both individual services and integrated solutions, recognising when a branding project can develop into a complete interior, product, and spatial design commission.

The successful candidate must be organised, proactive, confident in dealing with senior clients, and capable of coordinating with specialist teams without taking over their technical responsibilities.

**Compensation & Commission**

* Monthly salary: AED 18,000.
* Performance-based sales commission linked to agreed targets, collected revenue, and approved gross profitability.
* Commission will be calculated on eligible revenue actually collected, subject to management's approved commission structure.
* Opportunity to develop high-value commercial relationships across the UAE's art, design, corporate, government, hospitality, and retail sectors.

**How to Apply**

Candidates should submit their CV and a brief summary of their sales achievements, including revenue targets achieved, major contracts secured, relevant B2B client relationships, and experience in selling commercial services.

Applicants must demonstrate a proven ability to generate new business and close contracts independently.

This position is intended for an experienced sales professional, not a marketing specialist or general partnerships coordinator. Direct sales experience and a measurable record of revenue generation are essential.

Title: Supply Chain Director Saudi Arabia (Roche Diagnostics)
Head of Supply Chain, Americas
Description:
**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

As Sirio continues its expansion in North America, we are seeking a transformational Head of Supply Chain to lead and elevate the U.S. supply chain organization, ensuring exceptional customer service, operational efficiency, and scalable growth.

The Head of Supply Chain will provide strategic and operational leadership for all U.S.-based supply chain activities, including demand planning, supply planning, procurement, inventory management, customer supply chain collaboration, logistics, and S&OP.

Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Supply Chain and this individual will be responsible for creating a high-performing, data-driven supply chain organization that supports Sirio's commitment to quality, compliance, service, and continuous improvement.

**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Essential job functions and duties include, but are not limited, to:

**Inventory & Planning Excellence**

* Optimize inventory levels to improve working capital while maintaining service levels.
* Improve inventory accuracy, material availability, and planning discipline.
* Drive development of inventory policies, safety stock strategies, and replenishment methodologies.

**Logistics & Customer Supply Chain**

* Oversee inbound and outbound logistics strategies supporting domestic and international operations.
* Strengthen customer collaboration processes to improve forecast visibility and service performance.
* Ensure achievement of customer delivery commitments and OTIF objectives.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the supply chain organization.
* Use data and KPIs to identify opportunities for efficiency gains, waste reduction, and service improvements.
* Lead supply chain process digitization, automation, and systems improvements.
* Establish a culture where teams proactively solve problems, eliminate inefficiencies, and continuously raise performance standards.

**Compliance & Quality Partnership**

* Partner closely with Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and Operations to support FDA, GMP, and customer compliance requirements.
* Ensure robust material traceability, supplier qualification, and change management processes.
* Support customer audits and regulatory inspections as a supply chain subject matter expert.

**Global Supply Chain Collaboration & Network Integration**

* Serve as the primary U.S. supply chain leader and strategic partner to Sirio's Global Supply Chain organization, ensuring alignment between regional execution and global business objectives.
* Collaborate closely with Global teams to balance customer demand, manufacturing capacity, inventory strategies, and material availability across the global network.
* Drive alignment of production plans and inventory positioning between U.S. operations and international manufacturing sites to support customer service, working capital, and growth objectives.
* Partner with Global Logistics leadership to optimize international transportation, warehousing, import/export activities, and distribution strategies.
* Identify and mitigate supply risks related to global sourcing, extended lead times, transportation constraints, geopolitical events, and regulatory requirements.

* Establish standardized planning processes, KPI governance, and reporting practices that align with Sirio's global operating model.
* Support strategic initiatives involving network optimization, nearshoring, supplier diversification, and supply chain digitalization.
* Act as a key liaison between North American commercial teams and global operations, ensuring customer requirements are translated into executable supply and logistics plans.

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related discipline.

* 5+ years leading end-to-end supply chain functions within manufacturing environments.

* Willingness to spend an extended onboarding and immersion period in China during the first year of employment to develop relationships, gain a deep understanding of Sirio's global operations, manufacturing network, planning processes, and organizational culture.

Title: Manager Supply Chain Operations and Ssrvices
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Our Group Procurement & Logistics team delivers strategic sourcing and integrated supply chain solutions that strengthen operational resilience, optimise value and enable sustainable business performance.

The **Manager Supply Chain Operations and Services** will lead and manage end-to-end Supply Chain Operations and Group-wide functional governance and performance management of logistics services. They will ensure reliable, compliant and cost-effective distribution center operations, supply continuity, inventory and working-capital efficiency, service performance, compliance and cost effectiveness across planning, replenishment, warehousing, distribution, transportation and trade compliance. The role will drive an integrated operating model through standardised processes, digital enablement, performance governance and continuous improvement, while developing the people and capabilities required to support current and future business needs.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead and manage the Supply Chain Operations and Services function by developing and implementing tactical plans, priorities and objectives for the area of accountability, ensuring delivery of departmental strategy and business objectives. Set performance expectations and oversee multidisciplinary teams covering planning, replenishment, inventory management, distribution centres, logistics, supplier performance and trade compliance to ensure effective operational execution.
* Direct end-to-end supply chain execution of Uniform Distribution Centers, the General Distribution Center, warehousing, transportation and associated logistics services , ensuring consistent operating standards, capacity planning, resource deployment, operational readiness, service quality, inventory accuracy and effective fulfilment across all relevant locations and customer channels.
* Lead freight, transportation and warehousing services supporting Emirates business requirements, including air, sea and road movements and third-party logistics providers. Optimize capacity, routing, consolidation, service levels and total logistics cost. Monitor freight-market, carrier-capacity, geopolitical and regulatory developments and translate material risks into sourcing input, contingency planning and network decisions.
* Maintain accountability for product availability, supply continuity and inventory performance by directing the team to establish robust demand forecasting, appropriate inventory policies, segmentation, safety-stock levels and replenishment parameters, and to control stock-outs, excess, slow-moving and obsolete inventory.
* Manage strategic logistics providers and outsourced service arrangements by establishing clear governance, service-level agreements, performance measures, reporting requirements and escalation protocols. Direct provider reviews, corrective actions, mobilisation and operational transitions in collaboration with Procurement and relevant business stakeholders.
* Provide leadership and governance for customs and trade-compliance activities, ensuring that responsible teams, customs brokers and logistics providers maintain appropriate controls over declarations, tariff classification, duties and taxes, records, permits and regulatory authorisations.
* Lead supply chain transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across warehouse operations, logistics network optimisation, regional distribution centres, systems implementation, process standardisation and new service solutions. Develop business cases, implementation plans and change management activities to support successful delivery, stakeholder adoption and measurable business benefits.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

Act as a liaison between customers, service engineering teams, and support to address customer needs.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing a customer architecture with one of your SAs, then join a pipeline review with your Sales counterpart mid-morning. **Overview**
------------

The **Senior Land Surveyor (PMC)** is responsible for overseeing and managing all land surveying activities on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC) for a major infrastructure and landscape development project in Riyadh. The role involves coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure survey works are executed in accordance with project requirements, approved designs, quality standards, contractual obligations, and project schedules. The Senior Land Surveyor will provide technical leadership for surveying operations, monitor survey accuracy and compliance, manage survey-related risks, and ensure adherence to local regulations, project specifications, and industry best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

**Your role**
-------------

  

* Lead and manage all land surveying activities from project initiation through construction, commissioning, and project handover.
* Review and monitor survey deliverables, topographic surveys, geodetic surveys, setting out works, as-built surveys, and engineering survey submissions.
* Ensure survey activities comply with project requirements, local authority regulations, approved coordinates, and established control networks.
* Oversee contractor survey teams and monitor surveying activities against approved schedules and project milestones.
* Review and approve survey methodologies, survey reports, control point establishment, and technical survey submissions.
* Coordinate survey interfaces with civil, infrastructure, utilities, landscape, architectural, and specialist engineering disciplines.
* Conduct regular site inspections and survey audits to verify accuracy, quality, and compliance with approved designs and specifications.
* Monitor survey-related risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impacts on quality, cost, and schedule.
* Facilitate coordination meetings with contractors, consultants, clients, utility providers, and project stakeholders.
* Review and verify survey data, setting out records, quantity measurements, and as-built documentation.
* Track project KPIs, survey progress reports, and performance metrics for management and client review.
* Ensure proper survey controls, benchmarks, geospatial data management, and handover documentation are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support procurement activities including technical evaluations of survey equipment, systems, and specialist survey subcontractors.
* Drive resolution of technical and survey-related issues affecting project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality management requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and supervise survey engineers, surveyors, GIS specialists, and survey support teams.

**About you**
-------------

  

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Surveying, Geomatics Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geospatial Sciences, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 12-15 years of experience in land surveying, engineering surveying, and geospatial data management, with significant experience in PMC, consultancy, or client-side project delivery roles.
* Proven experience managing land surveying activities on large-scale infrastructure, transportation, utilities, landscape, urban development, or giga projects.
* Strong knowledge of topographic surveys, construction surveys, geodetic control networks, setting out, quantity measurement, and as-built surveys.
* Experience overseeing survey planning, control establishment, construction support surveying, verification surveys, and project handover activities.

Title: FACILITIES MAINTENANCE & CONTRACTOR SAFETY OFFICER
Description:
**Job Summery**

  

The Facilities Maintenance & Contractor Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of facility maintenance activities while managing contractor safety performance across the organization. The role focuses on maintaining a safe work environment, ensuring compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, and supporting the effective delivery of maintenance and facility management services.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Facilities Maintenance Management**

* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, safety standards, and organizational requirements.
* Support the implementation of energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives within facility operations.
* Monitor facility conditions and recommend corrective or improvement actions.
  

**Contractor Safety Management**

* Develop, implement, and enforce contractor safety policies and procedures.
* Conduct contractor pre-qualification assessments to evaluate safety performance, certifications, and compliance records.
* Review and approve Permit-to-Work (PTW) documentation, risk assessments, and method statements before work commences.

* Monitor contractor activities to ensure compliance with safety standards and PPE requirements.

* Conduct regular workplace safety inspections and facility audits.
* Identify safety hazards and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses to determine root causes and preventive measures.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety requirements, emergency procedures, and hazardous material management.
* Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and related safety documentation.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities and external auditors during inspections and compliance reviews.
  

**Emergency Preparedness & Response**

* Ensure fire protection systems, emergency exits, alarms, and first-aid facilities are properly maintained.
* Develop and coordinate emergency response and evacuation plans.
* Organize and monitor fire drills and emergency exercises.
* Act as a key liaison between facility management, emergency responders, and regulatory authorities during emergencies.
  

**Audits and Inspections**

* Conduct routine HSE inspections, fire risk assessments, and compliance audits.
* Utilize inspection checklists and assessment tools to evaluate workplace safety.
* Document findings and communicate corrective actions to relevant stakeholders.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Track contractor compliance metrics and monitor adherence to contractual HSE obligations.

* Monitor compliance with HSE policies, procedures, and standards across operations.
* Ensure subcontractors and service providers comply with organizational HSE requirements.

* Availability to respond to emergencies outside normal working hours is essential.
* Exposure to varying environmental conditions, hazardous materials, chemicals, animals, toxic plants, and specialized equipment may occur.
* Use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required when necessary.
* Physical activities may include standing, walking, climbing, bending, and lifting.
* Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and in challenging environmental conditions.

**Research Safety Manager**

**Regulatory Authorities & External Stakeholders**

Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.
