Title: Chief of Support Services
Description:
Job Responsibilities
  
  
The South Carolina Legislative Services Agency (LSA) is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief of Support Services Manager to lead and oversee all service-oriented operations supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. This position provides executive-level leadership support services including service desk, media support, legislative process, and information management and training, all within a non-partisan and apolitical environment.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager is accountable for ensuring exceptional customer service delivery across all support services by providing reliable, intuitive, and secure technology and operational support. This role is responsible for reducing service friction, improving user experience, and ensuring that service outcomes are measurable, transparent, and aligned with legislative business needs.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager serves as a trusted advisor to agency leadership and plays a critical role in aligning service delivery and operational planning with the mission and strategic goals of LSA. This role blends leadership, operational oversight, business analysis, and will work closely with project management to ensure high-quality, efficient, and innovative support services for the House of Representatives, Senate, and Legislative Council.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for all support services departments, ensuring streamlined, reliable, and responsive operations.
* Serve as the senior authority for service management initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, and execution of operational and technology-related services.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Agency Director on service delivery, operational effectiveness, organizational readiness, and change management.
* Lead and manage cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct comprehensive business, workflow, and service function analyses, including needs assessments and change impact evaluations.
* Define, recommend, and implement operational and service improvements using best-practice business processes and methodologies.
* Collaborate with the Senior Project Management lead for major agency initiatives, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and reporting to executive leadership.
* Lead the planning and implementation of special initiatives to support legislative bodies as they adapt to new technologies, methodologies, and lifecycle replacements.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, service frameworks, performance metrics, and improvement workflows.
* Partner with division and team managers to identify current and future projects, resource needs, and service priorities.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, service excellence, innovation, and accountability across all support services functions.
* Ensure all activities support the mission of LSA in a non-political, non-partisan, and behind-the-scenes capacity.

**Customer Service Delivery & Excellence**

* Ensure support services operate with a customer-first mindset, delivering reliable, intuitive, and secure services that meet the needs of legislative staff and stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in user experience by reducing service friction, improving response times, and proactively addressing recurring issues.
* Translate technical and operational decisions into clear business value that users can understand and experience.
* Own major service incidents and escalations end-to-end, ensuring timely communication, resolution, and post-incident review to prevent repeat occurrences.
* Serve as a visible, calm, and credible leader during service disruptions, setting expectations and communicating status, impacts, and resolutions in clear, non-technical language.
* Define, implement, and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to measure service reliability, responsiveness, and quality.
* Balance speed, quality, security, and compliance when delivering services and making operational decisions.
* Collect and analyze user feedback, service trends, and performance data to proactively improve services before issues escalate.
* Champion automation, self-service tools, and process improvements that enhance efficiency while maintaining service quality.

**Management & Leadership Responsibilities**

* Build, mentor, and retain high-performing service-oriented teams with a strong emphasis on professionalism, accountability, and customer service excellence.
* Coach staff in both technical competencies and soft skills, including communication, empathy, and stakeholder engagement.
* Establish clear roles, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability across support services teams.
* Act as the final escalation point for vendors and third-party partners, ensuring service commitments and performance expectations are met.

Manage service-related budgets and resources responsibly, justifying expenditures through demonstrated service outcomes
  
  
**Minimum And Additional Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, computer science, information management, or another IT or business-related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in:

+ IT business analysis
+ Project or program management
+ Personnel or team leadership

**Additional Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of business analysis techniques, needs assessments, and change management principles.
* Strong leadership and personnel management skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and develop teams.
* Advanced support services skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through completion.
* Exceptional planning, facilitation, communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Ability to understand both high-level strategic objectives and detailed operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict management skills.
* Proficiency in SharePoint, Microsoft Office, and IT support services methodologies, with demonstrated adaptability and a willingness to learn and support emerging AI technologies and models as the agency evolves.
* Excellent written communication skills for executive reporting, technical documentation, and professional correspondence.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a professional appearance and demeanor.
* Ability to logically analyze complex problems and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
* Ability to set priorities based on the unique needs of the House, Senate, and Legislative Council.
* Must be personable, polite, respectful, flexible, open-minded, and non-judgmental.
* Must be comfortable working in a non-political, behind-the-scenes support role.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to balance user expectations, operational constraints, and organizational priorities.
* Proven ability to explain complex technical or operational issues in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, escalations, and service recovery in high-visibility environments.
* Ability to make decisive, accountable decisions under pressure while maintaining professionalism and trust.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification (must be certified within a year of hire)
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green belt or higher).
* Experience working in a legislative, judicial, or government agency environment.

Experience establishing or improving
**service metrics, SLAs, KPIs, and performance dashboards**
Additional Comments
  
  
This is an onsite position operating within a professional government environment supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. The role requires frequent collaboration with executive leadership, technical teams, and service-oriented departments while maintaining strict non-partisanship and political neutrality. The work is mission-driven, service-focused, and essential to effective legislative operations. Success in this role requires a customer-first mindset, strong decision-making under pressure, clear and consistent communication, accountability and empathy for both service users and staff.
  
  
**Benefits For State Employees**
The state of South Carolina offers eligible employees generous benefits, including health and dental insurance; retirement and savings plan options; and paid vacation and sick leave. Plus, work-life balance programs such as telecommuting and flexible work schedules are available to employees of some state agencies.
  
  
**Insurance Benefits**
Eligible employees may enroll in health insurance, which includes prescription coverage and wellness benefits. Other available insurance benefits include dental, vision, term life insurance, long term disability and flexible spending accounts for health and child care expenses.
  
  
**Retirement Benefits**
State employees are also offered retirement plan options, including defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Additionally, eligible employees may elect to participate in the South Carolina Deferred Compensation Program, which is a voluntary, supplemental retirement savings plan offering 401(k) and 457 plan options.
  
  
**Workplace Benefits**
State employees may also be eligible for other benefits, including tuition assistance; holiday, annual and sick leave; and discounts on purchases, travel and more.
  
  
**Note:**
The benefits above are available to most state employees, with the exception of those in temporary positions. Employees in temporary grant and time-limited positions may be eligible for all, some or none of these benefits as benefits are associated with each position type. For these positions, contact the hiring agency to determine what benefits may be available.

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:
Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

We are seeking a seasoned and results-driven
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to provide strategic and executive leadership across our data center operations, with enterprise-wide accountability for operational excellence, mission-critical infrastructure availability, reliability, resilience, scalability, customer commitments, and service delivery.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO will play a pivotal role in translating Syntys’ ambitious growth strategy into scalable operational capabilities, building a high-performing organization, and ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of our data center platform.

The role encompasses executive leadership and oversight of Data Center Operations, Critical Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) Infrastructure, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability, ensuring integrated governance, operational resilience, and consistent performance across all markets.

The COO will be instrumental in enabling business growth and delivering world-class operational standards to meet the demanding requirements of hyperscale cloud providers, AI infrastructure customers, GPU-intensive computing environments, and wholesale colocation clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Enterprise Operations & Strategic Leadership:**
  Develop and execute the enterprise-wide operations strategy, establishing scalable, standardized, and performance-driven operating models across all markets and facilities.
* **Mission-Critical Infrastructure & Engineering Operations:**
  Oversee mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, power, fire protection, and facilities infrastructure, ensuring availability, reliability, uptime, and maintenance excellence. Ensure commissioning acceptance, integrated systems testing, and seamless transition from construction and project delivery into live operations.
* **Hyperscale & AI Infrastructure:**
  Drive operational readiness for hyperscale cloud, AI training, AI inference, and high-performance computing environments, including high-density power requirements, GPU infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling technologies, large-scale customer deployments, and phased capacity activation.
* **Executive Oversight of Operational Functions:**
  Provide executive oversight across headquarters and market operations, Critical Facilities Operations (Mechanical & Electrical), Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management (FM), Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability.
* **Operational Governance, Risk & Compliance:**
  Establish operational governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and controls across all facilities. Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency response, crisis management, operational audits, risk assessments, regulatory compliance, Operational Technology (OT) Security, cybersecurity resilience, and third-party operator and contractor performance. Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards and data center frameworks, including Uptime Institute Tier standards and relevant ISO standards.
* **Customer Experience & Strategic Account Management:**
  Ensure delivery against contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific requirements. Act as the senior executive escalation point for major operational incidents and customer concerns. Lead operational business reviews and support commercial growth through operational assurance and executive-level customer engagement.
* **Financial Performance, Asset Management & Sustainability:**
  Own operational expenditure (OPEX) performance and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning and investment prioritization. Drive cost optimization, asset lifecycle management, operational productivity, procurement effectiveness, vendor performance, budgeting, and financial forecasting. Lead energy efficiency, carbon reduction, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE).
* **Leadership, Organization & Talent Development:**
  Build and lead high-performing operations teams, establish clear organizational structures and leadership accountability, and drive succession planning, talent development, retention, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, operational discipline, safety, customer focus, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline. A Master's degree or relevant professional certifications are advantageous.
* **Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience**
  , including significant senior leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or critical facilities environments.
* Proven track record of leading
  **large-scale, multi-site or geographically distributed data center operations**
  , preferably at COO, SVP Operations, or equivalent senior leadership level.
* Solid experience managing
  **hyperscaler, cloud service provider, and strategic customer relationships**
  , with a strong understanding of contractual commitments, SLAs, and service delivery expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in
  **mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure**
  , including power systems, cooling technologies, maintenance strategies, operational reliability, and resilience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing key operational functions, including
  **Data Center Operations, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, IT, and Cybersecurity**
  , with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage operational interdependencies.
* Proven ability to manage
  **operational risks, critical incidents, business continuity, and crisis situations**
  , demonstrating sound judgment, accountability, and effective decision-making under pressure.
* Strong
  **commercial and financial acumen**
  , including operational budgeting, cost optimization, asset management, and vendor performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to
  **build and develop high-performing teams, strengthen operational governance, and scale operations**
  in a growing, multi-market business environment.
* Exposure to
  **AI infrastructure, high-density computing, GPU environments, and advanced cooling technologies**
  is highly desirable.

Title: Cybersecurity Consultant
Description:
**Location:** Doha, Qatar

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Consultant to deliver both hands-on security operations and expert advisory services to the organization and its clients. The role combines security monitoring, detection, incident response, threat analysis, and vulnerability coordination with cybersecurity consultancy, including security assessments, risk and compliance advisory, security architecture, and strategic roadmap development. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR/XDR, network security, identity security, cloud security, threat intelligence, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).

This role will support and strengthen security operations capabilities, lead complex security incidents and assessments, translate technical findings into clear business-focused recommendations, and work closely with clients, Infrastructure, Development, IT Operations, and management to reduce cyber risk, achieve regulatory compliance, and improve overall security maturity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. SOC Operations & Security Monitoring:

· Support and, where required, lead day-to-day SOC operations, ensuring continuous monitoring, alert triage, investigation, escalation, and response.

· Design, establish, and maintain SOC processes, operating procedures, runbooks, escalation paths, and shift models for the organization and its clients.

· Monitor security events across endpoints, servers, networks, identity platforms, cloud environments, applications, and security appliances.

· Ensure security alerts are investigated within defined priorities and response targets, with appropriate evidence and documentation.

· Continuously improve SOC workflows to reduce false positives, improve alert quality, and increase analyst efficiency.

2. SIEM, EDR/XDR & Security Tooling:

· Design, implement, and optimize SIEM operations, including log onboarding, normalization, correlation rules, dashboards, alerting, and retention.

· Configure and optimize EDR/XDR capabilities for endpoint detection, investigation, containment, and response.

· Ensure appropriate security telemetry is collected from firewalls, network devices, servers, applications, cloud platforms, identity services, and critical systems.

· Evaluate security tooling and provide vendor-neutral recommendations to improve detection, investigation, automation, and response capabilities.

· Develop and maintain security monitoring use cases aligned with business risks, threat intelligence, and emerging attack techniques.

3. Incident Response & Threat Management:

· Lead the investigation and response to high-severity cybersecurity incidents, including malware, ransomware, phishing, account compromise, data exfiltration, and unauthorized access.

· Coordinate containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities with technical teams, business stakeholders, and client representatives.

· Lead root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are identified, tracked, and completed.

· Develop, maintain, and facilitate testing of incident response plans, playbooks, and tabletop exercises.

· Support digital forensics and evidence preservation activities, engaging specialist resources when required.

4. Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting:

· Establish threat intelligence processes to identify relevant threats, indicators of compromise, vulnerabilities, and attacker tactics.

· Lead proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and SIEM data sources.

· Develop and tune detection rules, correlation logic, queries, and use cases based on MITRE ATT&CK and observed threats.

· Translate threat intelligence into actionable monitoring, detection, and advisory recommendations.

· Track emerging threats and assess their potential impact on the organization's and clients' technology environments.

5. Vulnerability & Security Exposure Management:

· Coordinate vulnerability monitoring and remediation activities with Infrastructure, Systems, Network, Application, and Cloud teams.

· Review vulnerability findings, prioritize remediation based on risk, and monitor closure of critical and high-risk issues.

· Monitor external attack surface, exposed services, misconfigurations, and security weaknesses.

· Plan, scope, and support penetration testing, security assessments, and remediation validation activities.

6. Cloud, Network & Infrastructure Security:

· Provide security oversight and advisory across Azure, Google Cloud, on-premises data centers, enterprise networks, servers, endpoints, and identity environments.

· Demonstrate strong understanding of firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, network segmentation, DNS, secure remote access, and network traffic analysis.

· Monitor cloud security events, IAM activity, privileged access, configuration risks, and security controls.

· Recommend and support hardening, patching, segmentation, MFA, privileged access, and secure configuration baselines.

7. Cybersecurity Consultancy & Advisory Services:

· Act as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, providing expert guidance on security strategy, risk, and technology decisions.

· Lead consulting engagements end-to-end, including scoping, planning, stakeholder interviews, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and close-out.

· Develop cybersecurity strategies, target operating models, and multi-year security roadmaps aligned with business objectives.

· Translate complex technical findings into clear, prioritized, and business-focused recommendations for executives and technical teams.

· Manage engagement timelines, deliverables, quality, and client expectations to ensure successful outcomes.

8. Security Assessments & Maturity Reviews:

· Conduct cybersecurity maturity assessments, gap analyses, and control reviews against recognized frameworks and regulatory requirements.

· Perform security architecture reviews, configuration reviews, and SOC capability and readiness assessments.

· Assess cloud, network, identity, endpoint, and application security posture and identify improvement opportunities.

· Prepare high-quality assessment reports, risk registers, executive summaries, and remediation plans.

9. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC):

· Advise on and support the implementation of security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and applicable national and sector regulations (e.g., Qatar NIA / NCSA requirements).

· Develop and review cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.

· Perform cybersecurity risk assessments, including risk identification, analysis, treatment planning, and tracking.

· Support internal and external audits, certification readiness, and compliance evidence preparation.

· Advise on third-party and supply chain security risk, data protection, and business continuity considerations.

10. Security Architecture & Solution Design:

· Design secure architectures and security solutions for on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

· Define security requirements and controls for new projects, solutions, and digital transformation initiatives.

· Apply security-by-design, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles across infrastructure, identity, and applications.

· Review and validate solution designs, implementation plans, and security configurations prior to deployment.

11. Pre-Sales, Proposals & Client Engagement:

· Support business development by understanding client requirements and designing appropriate cybersecurity service offerings.

· Prepare technical proposals, solution designs, scopes of work, effort estimates, and responses to RFPs/RFQs.

· Deliver client presentations, workshops, and solution demonstrations.

· Build and maintain strong long-term client relationships and identify opportunities for additional value-added services.

12. Knowledge Transfer, Reporting & Continuous Improvement:

· Define security KPIs and metrics covering alert volumes, response times, incident severity, detection effectiveness, SLA performance, risk posture, and remediation progress.

· Prepare regular security operations, risk, and engagement reports for senior management and clients.

· Mentor SOC analysts and engineers, and deliver knowledge transfer, training, and security awareness sessions.

· Drive automation and orchestration of repetitive security activities using SOAR, scripting, APIs, or equivalent technologies.

· Contribute to the development of internal methodologies, templates, toolkits, and service offerings.

**Required Qualifications:**

· Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

· 7+ years of cybersecurity experience, including significant hands-on experience in SOC operations, security monitoring, incident response, or security engineering.

· Demonstrated experience delivering cybersecurity consulting engagements, assessments, or advisory services in enterprise or client-facing environments.

· Strong hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, Elastic, or equivalent.

· Strong experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or equivalent.

· Strong understanding of network security including firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, segmentation, TCP/IP, DNS, proxy technologies, and network traffic analysis.

· Strong understanding of Windows and Linux security, Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, authentication, privileged access, and endpoint security.

· Hands-on experience with cloud security architecture, monitoring, and incident response in Azure and/or Google Cloud environments.

· Strong knowledge of incident response lifecycle, threat hunting, vulnerability management, and security investigation techniques.

· Experience with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence, IOC analysis, and detection use case development.

· Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and relevant national regulations (e.g., Qatar NIA).

· Proven experience conducting risk assessments, gap analyses, maturity assessments, and developing security policies and roadmaps.

· Experience preparing technical proposals, assessment reports, and executive-level presentations.

· Working knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent.

**Preferred Certifications:**

· CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional.

· CISM – Certified Information Security Manager, or CISA – Certified Information Systems Auditor.

· ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.

· GIAC certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, or GSTRT are an advantage.

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100) is an advantage.

· Cloud security certifications such as CCSP, AZ-500, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer are an advantage.

· Offensive security certifications such as OSCP or CEH are an advantage.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Strong consulting mindset with a client-focused, solution-oriented, and advisory approach.

· Excellent incident investigation, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

· Able to lead high-severity security incidents and client engagements calmly and effectively under pressure.

· Strong technical understanding across network, systems, endpoint, identity, application, and cloud security.

· Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex security risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.

· Strong report writing, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

· Able to manage multiple engagements and priorities while maintaining high quality standards.

· Fluency in English is required; Arabic is an advantage.

Title: Integrator

**Techify Inc.| Toronto, ON | Full-Time, Permanent | In Office 4+ Days/Week**

**Compensation: $140,000–$180,000 CAD + Performance Bonus**

Are you a confident, results-driven leader who thrives on solving problems, making decisions, and turning ambitious business goals into measurable results?

Do you enjoy leading strong teams, challenging the status quo, and bringing structure and accountability to a fast-moving organization?

**Techify is looking for an Integrator to partner with our Founder and CEO, lead our leadership team, and drive the execution of our business strategy.**

Our CEO owns the vision. You'll own making it happen.

Who We Are

Techify is a forward-thinking technology company helping businesses work smarter through proactive IT, cybersecurity, and AI-powered solutions.

Our mission is simple: **Leave People Feeling Smarter and Fired Up.**

We serve clients across Canada, operate using the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS), and believe in combining great people, smart technology, and disciplined execution to deliver exceptional results.

We're growing, evolving, and looking for a strong operational leader who can help take us to the next level.

**The Opportunity**

As Integrator, you'll have significant ownership of Techify's day-to-day performance, leading functional leaders, driving profitability, and ensuring our strategic priorities translate into results.

This is a hands-on executive leadership role for someone who enjoys making decisions, solving complex problems, building effective systems, and holding people accountable.

You'll work closely with our entrepreneurial CEO, bringing focus, structure, and execution to an environment filled with opportunity and new ideas.

**You'll have the authority to lead, the responsibility to deliver, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.**

**What You'll Own**

* **Lead the Leadership Team:** Direct, develop, and hold functional leaders accountable for performance, priorities, and results.
* **Drive Business Performance:** Own the P&L, profitability, budgets, and operational execution against company goals.
* **Turn Strategy Into Results:** Translate the CEO's vision and annual business plan into quarterly priorities, clear ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* **Make Decisions and Solve Problems:** Identify obstacles, resolve cross-functional challenges, and make timely decisions that keep the business moving forward.
* **Strengthen Systems and Accountability:** Lead our EOS operating rhythm, including weekly L10 meetings, Rocks, scorecards, and issue resolution.
* **Lead Change and Improvement:** Drive key initiatives, including AI transformation, process improvements, and operational scalability.
* **Build Alignment:** Ensure departments communicate effectively, execute consistently, and work toward shared objectives.

**What Makes You Successful**

You're a strong, self-directed leader who takes ownership, moves quickly, and gets results.

You bring:

* **Confidence and Decisiveness:** You're comfortable making difficult decisions, taking calculated risks, and challenging ideas when necessary.
* **Drive and Urgency:** You thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and push initiatives across the finish line.
* **Leadership and Accountability:** You set clear expectations, delegate effectively, and hold leaders responsible for delivering results.
* **Analytical Problem-Solving:** You use facts, financial data, and sound judgment to identify problems and determine the best path forward.
* **Structure Without Bureaucracy:** You build systems and processes that improve execution without slowing the business down.
* **Direct, Effective Communication:** You're straightforward, collaborative, and comfortable navigating difficult conversations while maintaining strong working relationships.

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

Title: Associate Administrative Officer (OPAS)
Description:
The Organizational Setting

Under the direction of the Director, Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau/ICAO (D/CDI), the Field Operations Section (FOS) is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and evaluation of programmes in the Capacity Development and Implementation (CDI) Bureau. FOS assists with the identification of priority development requirements across civil aviation and with technical cooperation to recipient States. It carries out resource mobilization with multilateral and bilateral development partners and industry. FOS develops regional and country-specific technical cooperation programmes and projects and executes these programmes and projects in accordance with the policies and contractual modalities of CDI.

The Associate Administrative Officer is a combined finance and administration function that oversees the project office’s administrative and accounting tasks under the CDI Project: FSA2201. The incumbent reports to and works under the supervision of the CDI Programme Manager overseeing the project, in accordance with the terms of reference set out in this job description. The position is located in the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) of Saudi Arabia, in Riyadh, and works in close coordination with the CDI Field Operations Officer, ICAO Headquarters, GACA, and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to ensure the efficient, compliant and timely delivery of all financial and administrative services required for the successful implementation of the project. The incumbent exercises professional judgement in planning and delivering assigned work, analysing issues and identifying appropriate action within established policies, procedures and responsibilities. Complex or exceptional matters are referred to the supervisor for guidance.

Major duties and Responsibilities

Function 1 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides accounting and financial support for the effective administration of the project office by reviewing transactions, monitoring resource use and applying established financial procedure, achieving results such as:**

* Collaborate with relevant authorities to prepare the annual manning requirement list and coordinate with ICAO-HQ for budget preparation and submission of the budget report to the GACA Finance Department on a yearly basis.
* Liaise with GACA to ensure proper budget administration, authorization, and project funding, and bring discrepancies or delays to the attention of the supervisor.
* Manage petty cash, process payments towards project office expenses, reconcile monthly expenses, and prepare and submit Electronic Journal Cash Transactions (EJCT) cash book reports to ICAO Finance in Montreal.
* Analyse and monitor petty cash balances against the established threshold stipulated under ICAO financial rules and regulations, identify and address variances, coordinate the timely deposit of excess funds to UNDP, and prepare monthly replenishment requests to ensure the project’s petty cash balance remains consistent.
* Monitor local payments and payment authorizations for ICAO OPAS Experts, vendors, and other project-related expenses through UNDP, ensuring proper fund transfers and timely follow-up.
* Review vendor statements and invoices for completeness and submit them for approval and/or facilitate payment processing and manage the financial aspects of the ICAO experts and support staff members under the project.
* Manage travel claim records of ICAO OPAS Experts, ensuring compliance with ICAO and ICSC standards, monitor unsettled claims, and follow up on payments.

Function 2 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides administrative support to the project office, achieving results such as:**

* Coordinate day-to-day administrative activities, draft and review routine correspondence and letters, coordinate and monitor official email correspondence, and monitor follow-up actions to support timely field-project implementation.
* Organize project documentation, and coordinate the review, finalization and signature of the Management Service Agreement (MSA), the ProDoc, and related records.
* Coordinate the procurement of office supplies, and official operational requirements from local markets, and facilitate the procurement of digital publications for GACA and ICAO OPAS Experts.
* Contribute to the review of project reports, presentations, and financial analysis for the CDI Programme Manager.
* Organize and maintain an orderly e-filing system and documentation of all assigned tasks, correspondence and reports, applying applicable records-management standards; ensuring confidentiality and compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations; such documents to be shared only with the consent of the CDI Programme Manager.

Function 3 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides personnel and contract administration support, achieving results such as:**

* Compile, Analyse and submit key reports such as the Monthly Strength Return, Quarterly Reports, and Annual Reports.
* Coordinate with GACA authorities/Department Heads and ICAO-HQ on critical administrative matters, including contract extensions, staff performance reports, probationary reports, new expert arrivals, and repatriation of OPAS Experts.
* Review, reconcile and submit travel expense claim reports and educational grant claim reports for ICAO experts, and review, verify and submit leave requests (Annual, Sick, Home Leave, Family Visit, Lump Sum, and Mission Requests) to ICAOHQ in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate with the travel agency to arrange flight itineraries and issue domestic airline tickets for approved official travel and missions.
* Maintain updated and accurate administrative records, including contract renewal documentation, annual staff performance reports? (SPRs), driving authorization letters, and vehicle insurance records.
* Liaise with UNDP and GACA to facilitate the issuance and renewal of UN/GACA identification cards (IDs), and manage government-related requests such as Visas, IQAMA, Multiple Re-entry Visas, Final Exit Visas, and Driving Licenses through coordination with UNDP, UNRC and GACA.
* Coordinate training requirements for ICAO experts, including liaison with ICAO Global Aviation Training (GAT) Section, and prepare employment-related letters (bank letters, visa request letters, staff arrival letters, etc.).

Function 4 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides coordination, meetings and stakeholder support, achieving results such as:**

* Organize annual, quarterly and urgent meetings for the project office, and prepare draft agendas and minutes of the meetings (MOM) for project records.
* Liaise with GACA, ICAO, UNDP, UNDSS, UNRC and other relevant offices for project coordination, recruitment, and administrative support, and assist in meetings with these stakeholders to address project requirements.
* Facilitate recruitment processes, including coordination with GACA and ICAO for candidate approvals and onboarding, and assist with contract extensions, SPR, and repatriation processes for project staff.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination across all stakeholders, inside and outside the project office, for the effective implementation of the project.
* Maintain the confidentiality of all project-related data and ensure compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations.

Function 5 (incl. Expected results)

**Performs any other duties as required for the successful and timely implementation of the programme.**

Impact of The Outcome of the Position

The Associate Administrative Officer ensures effective project administration by managing communications, documentation, and stakeholder coordination. This role directly supports project efficiency, compliance, and the seamless operation of administrative tasks within the ICAO-CDI Project. The position plays a key role in maintaining efficient administrative operations, ensuring compliance with policies, and supporting project coordination, which directly impacts smooth project execution and stakeholder collaboration.

Work Relations and Contacts

The Associate Administrative Officer reports to the GACA Authorities in close coordination with the CDI Programme Manager. The incumbent also coordinates with ICAO experts on administrative matters, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.

COMPETENCIES

**Core Competencies** **:**

**Professionalism** : Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work.

**Teamwork** : Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise; is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda; supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position; shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.

**Communication:** Speaks and writes clearly and effectively; listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately; asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication; tailors language, tone, style, and format to match the audience; demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed.

**Planning and Organizing** : Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies; identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required; allocates appropriate amount of time and resources for completing work; foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning; monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary; uses time efficiently.

**Accountability** : Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honours commitments; delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards; operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules; supports subordinates, provides oversight and takes responsibility for delegated assignments; takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.

**Client Orientation** : Considers all those to whom services are provided to be “clients ” and seeks to see things from clients’ point of view; establishes and maintains productive partnerships with clients by gaining their trust and respect; Identifies clients’ needs and matches them to appropriate solutions; monitors ongoing developments inside and outside the clients’ environment to keep informed and anticipate problems; keeps clients informed of progress or setbacks in projects; meets timeline for delivery of products or services to client.

Qualifications and Experience

Education

**Essential**

* A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s) in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

**Desirable**

* An advanced university degree (Master’s) in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

Professional Experience

**Essential**

* A minimum of four years of relevant experience in administration, finance, or project management, preferably in aviation or international projects.
* Proficiency in financial reporting, budget management, and cash management.
* Proven experience in office management and administrative procedures.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi-task, and strong attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, with experience in coordinating with international and local organizations and various stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint), document editing software (Microsoft Office, Adobe Pro), financial software and ERP systems.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of ICAO CDI – Field Service Staff Rules (FSSR) and associated Personnel Instructions (PIs).
* Experience in vendor management and procurement.
* Experience and knowledge in the aviation industry.

Languages

**Essential**

* Fluent reading, writing and speaking abilities in English.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of any of the other languages of the Organization (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).

Professional Category (P-2)

Title: Senior Systems Engineer - Enterprise Services
Description:
The Senior Systems Engineer – Enterprise Services is responsible for the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions across ZainTECH's customer environments. The role ensures the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical infrastructure services while providing advanced technical support and maintaining operational standards in accordance with customer requirements and industry best practices.

Working closely with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists, the Senior Systems Engineer supports the full lifecycle of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including deployment, configuration, migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. The role also contributes to infrastructure improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure effective service delivery and long-term operational stability.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Infrastructure Administration & Operations

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based systems across customer environments.
* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly operational activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of critical infrastructure services.
* Monitor system health, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential operational issues.
* Implement and maintain system configurations, security controls, and operational procedures in accordance with established best practices.
* Support the administration of enterprise infrastructure services, ensuring secure and reliable access for authorized users.
* Perform preventive maintenance, system updates, and routine operational checks to minimize service disruptions.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

* Provide advanced technical support to enterprise customers through on-site and remote troubleshooting.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure incidents, system failures, and performance-related issues.
* Support major customer accounts through proactive technical engagement, issue resolution, and ongoing service improvement.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including Active Directory, Exchange Server, Microsoft 365, virtualization, and cloud services.
* Escalate complex technical issues to relevant specialists or vendors where required, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to customer IT teams to support effective system administration and operational continuity.

Infrastructure Implementation & Migration

* Install, configure, deploy, and integrate enterprise infrastructure solutions in accordance with approved technical designs and customer requirements.
* Implement Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including identity services, messaging platforms, virtualization, and cloud-based solutions.
* Support and supervise infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and system modernization activities while minimizing disruption to customer operations.
* Configure and optimize infrastructure environments to meet performance, availability, and security requirements.
* Coordinate implementation activities with Project Managers, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
* Validate infrastructure configurations and ensure deployed solutions meet agreed technical specifications and operational requirements.

Microsoft Cloud & Enterprise Services

* Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, identity management, authentication, and access control solutions.
* Support Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and associated collaboration technologies.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments and related infrastructure services.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Azure AD Connect, Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Administer Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, storage accounts, and related cloud resources.
* Support Microsoft Intune, information protection, and enterprise mobility and security capabilities.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery solutions using Microsoft Azure and associated technologies.

Testing, Documentation & Reporting

* Perform system integration testing, configuration validation, and operational readiness assessments for implemented solutions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, implementation records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Document infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure accurate technical records.
* Provide regular technical status updates and progress reports to Project Managers, supervisors, and relevant stakeholders.
* Communicate incidents, technical risks, and operational issues clearly, escalating matters requiring management attention.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance infrastructure performance, security, and service delivery quality.

*Our Culture & Code of Conduct:*

*At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from ho we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally.*

 **Requirements**

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of experience in Microsoft infrastructure administration, enterprise systems engineering, or related IT infrastructure roles.
* Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, including user management, authentication, and directory services.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and related collaboration platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technologies.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) and hybrid identity environments.
* Experience configuring and supporting Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Microsoft System Center products and enterprise infrastructure management technologies.
* Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including:
* + Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, and related infrastructure services.
  + Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Azure AD Connect.
  + Enterprise Mobility & Security: Microsoft Intune, Azure Rights Management, and associated security capabilities.
  + Monitoring & Operations: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related infrastructure monitoring services.
  + Backup & Disaster Recovery: Azure Site Recovery and Azure Backup.
* Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, system upgrades, migrations, and technical troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure security, system availability, performance optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic.
* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Title: Technical Supervisor - Digital Delivery - Civil 3D/ Naviswork - Infra/ utilities
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

AECOM Middle East Infrastructure delivers civil and utility infrastructure design across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The Digital Delivery / BIM team models and documents wet utilities, dry utilities, MEICA and smart technology networks for these projects, and is responsible for the quality, coordination and timely issue of the information that comes out of them.

**Purpose of the role**

Supervise a group of BIM team leads delivering concurrent infrastructure projects, and carry the accountability for what that group produces. On the team's responsibility assignment matrix this is the second most accountable position after the BIM Manager: it owns resource deployment, clash resolution, validation of model and drawing submissions, and the final check before anything is issued for design review.

**Key responsibilities**

**Deployment and progress**

* Own the deployment of resource across the group's disciplines, and rebalance it as project demand moves.
* Chair production progress meetings and discipline coordination meetings for the group.
* Own the key performance indicators reported for the group, and the progress position on clash and issue resolution.
* Onboard third parties brought in to support the project team.

**Delivery management**

* Own model and drawing delivery for the group, against the master information delivery plan and the discipline task information delivery plans.
* Own the standards that the work is produced to: NOC data standardisation, base plan standardisation, base plan and title block milestone requirements, and the authoring tool template files.
* Own data shortcut setup and the part catalogue or object library arranged for each project.
* Own the implementation of design automation in support of the production teams.
* Maintain the single source of truth for the 2D extraction of drawings.

**Validation and issue**

* Validate discipline model submissions against the model checklist, and BIM data for GIS submission against the GIS checklist.
* Own the drawing checklist and CAD standard compliance check.
* Perform the final drawing sanity check before anything is issued to discipline or interdisciplinary review.
* Own quantity take-off compliance where it feeds the bill of quantities.

**Clash and interface**

* Own the clash resolution activity for the group, end to end.
* Issue direction and provide the solution where a clash needs a decision.
* Agree the solution with the engineering team and establish which modeller carries the fix.
* Ensure interfaces and tie-ins between disciplines and with third parties are coordinated.

**People**

* Deliver internal training on the authoring tools, and confirm the group's capability against project requirements.
* Manage performance and development for the team leads reporting to the role.
* Support recruitment, technical interviewing and onboarding.

**Technical requirements**

* Civil 3D and AutoCAD to an advanced level, with a working command of Navisworks for clash and interface management.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360, including model coordination spaces and package sharing.
* ISO 19650 in practice: BIM execution plan, master and task information delivery plans, information states and level of information need.
* Data shortcuts, part catalogues, object styles and authoring templates at a level that lets the role set them for others.

The GCP Operations Architect is a resident member of a cloud managed-services team, responsible for the day-to-day operation, support and maintenance of a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment, with limited support for integrated on-premises infrastructure and hybrid connectivity. He works alongside the Cloud Engineers to keep the platform stable, secure and available, and to align operations with architectural standards and best practices.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Own the platform's operational architecture: resource hierarchy, org policies, Shared VPC and IAM model.
* Act as design authority for changes and new workload onboarding, producing HLD/LLD designs.
* Deploy, provision and maintain GCP infrastructure and manage project and resource lifecycle.
* Resolve incidents within SLAs, lead RCA for major incidents and drive architectural corrective actions.
* Manage VPCs, routing, firewalls, VPN/Interconnect, DNS, load balancers and hybrid connectivity.
* Design HA, backup and disaster recovery strategies, and run restore tests and DR drills.
* Oversee OS patching (Linux/Windows), routine maintenance, health checks and capacity planning.
* Maintain Terraform modules and Cloud Build CI/CD pipelines, and automate recurring operational tasks.
* Manage IAM, firewall policies and Cloud KMS keys; support security, compliance and audit requirements.
* Maintain monitoring, alerting and logging, and deliver operational and FinOps reports
* Mentor Cloud Engineers, maintain runbooks and documentation, and transfer knowledge to customer teams.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 4+ years of hands-on public cloud experience (GCP preferred) operating production environments.
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (mandatory).
* Strong experience with GCP Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring and Logging.
* Experience designing and governing GCP landing zones (resource hierarchy, org policies, Shared VPC).
* Strong cloud networking: VPC design, VPN/Interconnect, DNS, firewalls and load balancing.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform and CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build or similar).
* Proven ITIL-based incident, problem and change management experience, including RCA.
* Linux and Windows administration, patching, and backup and restore experience.
* Fluent Arabic and English, with strong communication and documentation skills (HLD/LLD, runbooks).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Experience working in a resident or managed-services model with defined SLAs.
* Experience designing HA/DR architectures and running DR drills on Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of cloud cost management and optimization strategies, including FinOps principles (budgets, CUDs, rightsizing, labeling).
* Experience with Cloud KMS, Secret Manager and cloud security posture tools.
* Scripting skills in Python, Bash or PowerShell.
* Experience with hybrid environments and core infrastructure services (e.g. AD, DNS, DHCP).
* Knowledge of local and international compliance and regulatory frameworks (NCA, ISO 27001).
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms.

* English.

Title: Network Engineer
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Network Engineer** to manage, maintain, and operate the Ministry's network infrastructure across its headquarters and governorate branches.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, Cisco infrastructure, routing and switching, wireless LAN configuration, firewall administration, network monitoring, and information security.

The successful candidate will ensure network availability, performance, security, and operational continuity while supporting infrastructure improvements and technical operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Network Infrastructure & Administration**

* Manage daily network operations and technical activities related to IT infrastructure.
* Install, configure, operate, and maintain network switches, Cisco Wireless Controllers, and Cisco Voice Gateways.
* Configure and manage VLANs and perform necessary switch modifications.
* Manage Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols, routing, and switching.
* Monitor network connectivity, internet links, leased lines, and overall network performance.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to resolve connectivity issues.

**Wireless Networking & Security**

* Configure and maintain enterprise wireless networks using Cisco, Ruckus, and HP/Aruba technologies.
* Prepare and analyze passive and active Wi-Fi heatmaps.
* Monitor firewall operations, perform necessary updates, and ensure security configurations are maintained.
* Implement information security policies, technical circulars, and network security requirements.
* Manage and monitor network security devices and associated infrastructure.

**Network Monitoring & Communication Systems**

* Monitor and maintain Cisco Call Manager, IP telephony, billing systems, and video communication infrastructure.
* Monitor network devices and connectivity using Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.
* Monitor MPLS, leased lines, DSL connections, and other network links.
* Monitor UPS systems and backup batteries to prevent infrastructure interruptions.

**Backup, Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain secure backups of network devices and configurations before and after every major change.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including device configurations, connectivity details, and network diagrams using Microsoft Visio.
* Maintain updated infrastructure plans, network drawings, and operational documentation.
* Prepare monthly and on-demand technical reports covering assigned activities, incidents, and resolutions.

**Infrastructure Management & Knowledge Transfer**

* Supervise network infrastructure and server room operations.
* Identify potential network failures and implement preventive measures to ensure service continuity.
* Analyze network equipment specifications and recommend infrastructure improvements.
* Develop operational plans and organize technical tasks to ensure business continuity.
* Provide knowledge transfer, technical guidance, and training to the Ministry's IT staff.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Networking, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum **5+ years of professional experience** in Network Engineering / Network Administration.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols.
* Practical experience with routing and switching technologies, particularly Cisco and HP/Aruba.
* Strong experience configuring and managing enterprise wireless networks using Cisco, Ruckus, and HP/Aruba.
* Ability to prepare and analyze active and passive Wi-Fi heatmaps.
* Knowledge of structured cabling systems, including passive network infrastructure.
* Experience with MPLS, leased lines, DSL connections, and ISP coordination.
* Knowledge of Cisco IP Phones, Cisco Call Manager, and voice communication systems.
* Familiarity with Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.
* Experience with Cisco Firepower 5508 and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (1000-D, 501E, and 60E).
* Strong troubleshooting, network security, and infrastructure management skills.
* Excellent documentation, reporting, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and under pressure.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, and overtime when required.

**Mandatory Certifications**

Candidates must hold relevant networking and infrastructure certifications, including:

* MCSE – Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert.
* CCNA – Cisco Certified Network Associate.
* CCNP – Cisco Certified Network Professional.

**Additional Preferred Certifications**

* VCP-DCV – VMware Certified Professional, Data Center Virtualization.
* VCP-NV – VMware Certified Professional, Network Virtualization.
* MCITP – Microsoft Certified IT Professional.

Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles will be an added advantage.

**Nationality Preference**

* Omani Nationals – First Preference.
* Non-Omani Nationals – Second Preference.

Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated CV, clearly highlighting their networking experience, Cisco and firewall expertise, and relevant certifications.
