Title: Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration
Description:
**Job Description**

  

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

**AI Disclosure:** As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
* Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
* Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
* Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
* Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
* Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
* Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
* Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
* Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
* Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.
* Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, analytics teams, product owners, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business outcomes and enterprise standards.
Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices, documentation standards, stakeholder communications, and operational processes.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Project Analyst, or in a similar role supporting data, software, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience working with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, reporting, data integration, or related enterprise technology.
* Experience supporting complex technology change, migration, modernization, or transformation initiatives, including coordination across multiple teams and dependencies.
* Strong documentation skills, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, meeting outcomes, decisions, and status reporting.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and delivery tracking.
* Ability to understand and communicate data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, business processes, and impacts across upstream and downstream teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, assess impacts, and organize complex information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for business and technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align teams with differing priorities.
* Proficiency with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse or data platform migrations, particularly from on-premises Oracle environments to cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting large-scale or complex migrations involving data, ETL/ELT processes, reports, interfaces, or downstream consumers.
* Experience with data governance, data quality management, metadata, data cataloging, lineage, or master/reference data practices.
* Experience defining migration approach, scope, business impacts, dependencies, readiness criteria, and validation or reconciliation plans.
* Familiarity with SQL and the ability to review queries, data structures, mappings, and reconciliation results.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, defect triage, business sign-off, and post-release validation.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with formal security, privacy, risk, or change-management practices.
Familiarity with tools such as Lucidchart, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent requirements and process-mapping tools.

You will coordinate response efforts, keep corporate stakeholders informed, and engineer the playbooks and tooling that make our response faster and more consistent. You will also work with our on-call engineers to raise the quality of alert investigation across the organization.

This is a senior individual contributor role on the technical track. You will lead projects, mentor teammates, and influence colleagues at every level.

**\*\*Note this individual must be based in Canada.**

* Partner closely with Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering, supporting their investigations as needed

* Be available on an as-needed basis, including outside normal hours, to be called in to run response activities for significant incidents (eg. On-call potential)

* Share timely, accurate information with corporate stakeholders (Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Support, and leadership)

* Help write incident summaries, RCAs (including customer-facing), and DRI contributions

* Engineer and maintain version-controlled playbooks, and build automation to detect and correct drift across detections, SOAR workflows, and tooling

* Partner with on-call engineers to improve alert investigation quality through better playbooks, enrichment, and feedback

* Report on triage quality and incident response metrics to security leadership

* Work with the Security Operations resources on tabletop exercises and annual incident response training

* Mentor teammates on investigation technique and escalation judgment
* Use AI as a force multiplier to provide more efficient and effective IR workflows

* Understand and comply with multiple compliance frameworks and regulations

Adhere to Genesys Code of Business Conduct and Ethics

* Deep familiarity with SIEM solutions (e.g., Splunk, Sumo Logic, Elastic)

* Strong working knowledge of AWS and cloud-native security and logging

* Familiarity with threat intelligence tools (e.g., Recorded Future)

* Comfort with web applications and their attack models

* Experience working in a SaaS company supporting regulated workloads

* Experience building or automating playbooks and detections (SOAR, scripting, or detection-as-code)

* Experience documenting incidents, including customer-facing RCAs

* Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, including legal and executive stakeholders

* Ability to influence peers and partner teams without direct authority

* Sound judgment, strong intuition, and the ability to work independently

* Detail oriented and systematic

Willingness to be called in outside normal working hours to lead response for significant incidents  

  

**Desirable**

* Industry-relevant certifications (e.g., GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CIM, CISSP)

* Experience coaching engineers on security investigation practices

* Experience responding to incidents and abuse events in environments with public APIs
* Experience with AI and MCP tooling, whether chat, agentic, or developer-assisted (e.g., Claude, Kiro, ChatGPT)

Title: Infrastructure Consultant, Network and Datacenter
Description:
What do you think of when you hear the name MNP? Most likely tax and accounting, but as one of Canada’s largest consulting organizations, we’re so much more! We’re also serious about technology.

Make an impact with our Digital Managed Services team as an Infrastructure Consultant. In this client-facing role, you will plan and deliver the infrastructure projects that keep organizations connected, secure and resilient. You’ll own medium-complexity engagements from discovery through delivery and handover, including network refreshes, firewall deployments and migrations, wireless rollouts, server and virtualization upgrades, and hybrid connectivity to Azure. You’ll work alongside project managers, architects and our managed services teams to build environments that clients can rely on and that our teams can support well.

This role involves working from an MNP office and/or on-site with clients, depending on the needs of the engagement. The ideal candidate will work from one of our offices in Montreal, Edmonton, Calgary or Burlington.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead medium-complexity infrastructure projects from assessment and design through implementation, testing and handover.
* Assess client environments and design secure, scalable network, server, virtualization and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Design and implement LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, firewall, VPN and network security solutions.
* Deliver server, Active Directory, virtualization, backup, disaster recovery and Azure migration projects.
* Perform infrastructure health and security assessments and recommend improvements to performance, resilience and lifecycle management.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide escalation support to managed services teams.
* Automate repeatable administrative and configuration tasks to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Facilitate client workshops, provide knowledge transfer and maintain technical documentation, including designs, diagrams and handover materials.
* Manage deliverables within project scope, timelines and budgets, identifying risks and changes as needed.
* Support solution scoping, effort estimates and statements of work for new client opportunities.
* Build strong client relationships and contribute to delivery standards, methodologies and leading practices.
* Travel to client sites approximately 25% to 30% of the time.

**Skills and Experience**

* Post-secondary education in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of experience designing, implementing and supporting enterprise network and server infrastructure.
* 2+ years of consulting, professional services or project delivery experience.
* Experience delivering network refreshes, firewall migrations, enterprise wireless, server and virtualization upgrades, and backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of:
  + **Networking:** Cisco, Fortinet, routing, switching, SD-WAN and enterprise wireless.
  + **Security:** Fortinet FortiGate, Check Point, Cisco Meraki, firewalls, VPNs and network segmentation.
  + **Servers and virtualization:** Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V.
  + **Cloud and recovery:** Microsoft Azure, hybrid connectivity, Veeam, Azure Backup or similar technologies.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, infrastructure monitoring and management tools.
* Experience with PowerShell; Python or Ansible experience is an asset.
* Strong technical troubleshooting, client communication, documentation and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple client engagements and competing priorities.
* Ability to obtain a criminal record check and federal security clearance.
* French language skills are an asset.
* Cisco, Fortinet, Check Point, Windows Server or Microsoft Azure certifications are considered strong assets.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within a managed services or information technology services organization.
* Firewall migrations, network refreshes, SD-WAN migrations and multi-site deployments.
* Cisco Meraki cloud-managed network migrations.
* Hypervisor, data centre, server or Azure workload migrations.
* Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft 365 migration projects.
* Linux administration and infrastructure patch/lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with Information Technology Infrastructure Library practices and formal change management.

**MY REWARDS @ MNP**

With a focus on high-potential earnings, MNP is proud to offer customized rewards that support our unique culture and a balanced lifestyle to thrive at work and outside of the office. You will be rewarded with generous base pay, vacation time, 4 paid personal days, a group pension plan with 4% matching, voluntary savings products, bonus programs, flexible benefits, mental health resources, exclusive access to perks and discounts, professional development assistance, MNP University, a flexible ‘Dress For Your Day’ environment, firm sponsored social events and more.

Title: Network Operation Center Supervisor I
Description:
**Job Title:** Network Operations Center Supervisor I

**Department:** Network Operation Center

**Reports to:** Network Operations Center Manager

**Location:** On-site located in Spokane Valley, WA

**About NoaNet**

NoaNet is a non-profit mutual corporation providing telecom solutions and services and is headquartered in Spokane Valley, Washington. For over 20 years, NoaNet has operated a reliable public open-access broadband network that today totals over 3,800 fiber miles and touches every county in Washington State. Our organization provides rural areas access to broadband services, supporting more than 100 last-mile providers that serve more than 260,000 customers. NoaNet’s owner/members are nine public utility districts and a joint operating agency. Learn more about NoaNet at https://noanet.net.

**Career Overview**

Support network operations center analysts in a leadership role by leading, training, and coaching a team of network analysts to provide superior customer support relating to monitoring, troubleshooting and repairing NoaNet’s and our NCS members networks consisting of multiple systems including PON, carrier Ethernet, and MPLS. Provide technical support to clients via telephone, remote access, and on-site service; provide circuit design support by interfacing with engineering, provisioning, and customers; provide technical expertise and training to network operations analyst for troubleshooting and maintenance of the network and associated equipment, interface with installers to test and turn up new circuit orders; and other duties as assigned. Provide field support to install, maintain and troubleshoot circuits and systems and, work closely with NoaNet’s engineering and sales teams, and provide guidance and support to contract installers.

**Responsibilities**

* Supervise a team of network analyst to provide superior customer service through effective leadership, documentation, training, and coaching techniques.
* Provide exceptional customer service by possessing strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ensure NOC Analysts are properly trained and adhere to company policies associated with monitoring the network, proper call handling techniques, and best practice troubleshooting skills.
* Work closely with the field engineering and engineering teams in support of installations, provisioning, troubleshooting, and repair of the network following good engineering practices with a primary focus of network reliability.
* Install and configure network equipment for service order implementation and train network operations analysts to do the same.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and maintain a positive attitude.
* Provide telephone-based technical support to clients and customers.
* Train network operations analysts in learning NoaNet’s network architecture, equipment, troubleshooting techniques, and industry standard installation practices.
* Assist in maintaining the internal IT infrastructure of NoaNet systems.
* Assist field installers configuring the network to complete circuit order installations.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, and PC and server hardware.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of structured cabling.
* Possess intermediate knowledge of installation, maintenance and troubleshooting practices to install and maintain optical systems and cabling.
* Possess basic Windows and/or Linux/Unix server knowledge.
* Have ability and motivation to learn new technologies on own quickly and with minimal support and guidance.
* Demonstrate clear and professional communications both verbally and in writing.
* Have ability to read, listen to, and follow complex technical instructions, as well as research, locate, and follow written technical documentation.
* Provide direction, training, and mentoring to others.
* Work independently, organizing and setting priorities with minimal supervision.
* Be available to respond to emergencies 24/7/365.
* Seek and take advantage of opportunities for professional growth.
* Ability to install, maintain and troubleshoot MPLS, Ethernet and optical networking equipment.
* Complete and submit work orders, job tickets, time records, reports, and assignments promptly and efficiently.
* Other duties assigned.

  

**Education, Training, Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications**

* Understanding of IP/Ethernet routing and switching.
* Familiarity with Routing Protocols.
* Configuring and troubleshooting Ethernet circuits (VLANs) on a service provider network.
* Advanced knowledge of Core, Distribution, and Access layer designs and topologies.
* Familiarity with best network security practices.
* Cisco, Nokia, or similar certification or the ability to obtain the required certification within 6 months (equivalent certifications accepted).
* Knowledge and experience with process management and improvement techniques.
* Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
* Strong organizational, coordination, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
* Strong people skills and the willingness to be accountable for results.
* Ability to set own priorities as well as manage time responsibly.
* Must have excellent customer relationship skills.
* Required – Comptia Network+ Certification.
* Desirable – ALU MPLS Certification(s) – NRS1.

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to perform the essential job functions, including any required physical duties, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be made in accordance with applicable law.
* Maintain dress and appearance appropriate for a professional office setting.

  

**Working Conditions**

* Regularly sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk and hear.
* Frequently stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Regularly lift and move up to 10 lb., frequently lift and move up to 20 lb., and occasionally lift and move up to 50 lb.
* Use close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and have ability to adjust focus.

  

**Driving Requirements**

* Must maintain and possess a valid driver’s license, proof of insurance, and a satisfactory driving record.

  

**Location**

  

* On-site at Redwood Plaza located in Spokane Valley, Washington

  

**Wage**

* Wage range $32.56/hr - $46.00/hr DOE non-exempt position

  

**Benefits**

* Defined Benefit Retirement Plan through the WA State Department of Retirement Systems
* 457b Optional Supplement Plan
* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance
* Accidental Death and Long Term Disability Plan
* Combined Paid Leave
* 11 Paid Holidays

Reporting directly to the Manager, Network Inventory, Warehouse Operations and Tool Management, this role bridges strategic network goals and ground-level execution. The Supervisor plays a critical lead role in publishing standardized procedures (DPDs) across all departments and base locations, leading new employee onboarding and training programs, integrating new outbases, driving AMOS system process adoption, and supporting centralized distribution strategies—ensuring full regulatory compliance (CARs, IOSA), high material availability, and process governance.

Duties & Responsibilities:

* **Network-Wide Process Uniformity:** Roll out standardized DPD workflows for receiving, binning, cycle-counting, parts issuing, AOG support, and shipping across primary hubs (YYZ, YTZ, YQT, YAM, YOW, YHZ) and outbases to eliminate local operational variances.
* **Onboarding & Training Standards:** Oversee and facilitate all new employee onboarding, maintaining high training standards and OJT programs across all departments and personnel responsible for material handling to ensure strict compliance with IOSA and Transport Canada regulations.
* **Process Compliance & Auditing:** Perform regular process audits across bases to ensure local stores teams strictly adhere to established DPDs and CARs/IOSA regulatory guidelines.
* **Create & Publish DPDs:** Author, publish, and continuously update all Departmental Process Documents (DPDs) to establish a single, unified operational playbook and ensure standardization across all departments, logistics, and warehouse operations.
* **Outbase Integration:** Project-manage the operational setup and supply chain integration of new outbases and heavy check stations.
* **Systems Integration & Workflow Automation:** Partner with the Manager to translate AMOS and Vertical Lift Module (VLM) operational workflows into standard DPDs, driving network adoption of AMOS APNs to reduce email traffic and automate material requests.

Behavioural Competencies:

* **Concern for Safety:** Identifying hazardous or potentially hazardous situations and taking appropriate action to maintain a safe environment for self and others.
* **Teamwork:** Working collaboratively with others to achieve organizational goals.
* **Passenger/Customer Service:** Providing service excellence to internal and/or external customers (passengers).
* **Initiative:** Dealing with situations and issues proactively and persistently, seizing opportunities that arise.
* **Results Focus:** Focusing efforts on achieving high quality results consistent with the organization’s standards.
* **Fostering Communication:** Listening and communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully with different audiences, promoting dialogue and building consensus.

Qualifications:

* **Experience:** 3+ years of experience in aviation inventory, logistics, or warehouse management, with a strong background in process documentation, workflow design, or multi-site process standardization.
* **Documentation & Writing Skills:** Strong technical writing ability with proven experience creating, publishing, and maintaining formal procedures, SOPs, or Departmental Process Documents (DPDs).
* **Project Leadership:** Track record of leading logistics projects, outbase setup initiatives, or continuous improvement efforts.
* **Technical & Systems Expertise:** Deep familiarity with aviation maintenance software (AMOS experience highly preferred) and automated storage systems (VLM).
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** Solid understanding of Canadian Aviation Regulations (CARs), IOSA standards, and aviation Safety Management Systems (SMS).
* **Education & Credentials:**
* + Post-secondary education in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, or Aviation Management is an asset.
  + AME (Aircraft Maintenance Engineer) license or technical maintenance background is an asset.
* **Travel Requirements:** Ability to travel regularly across network outbases to perform process reviews, train staff on DPDs, and manage rollout projects.

Title: IT Specialty - Major Incident Commander
Description:
**Title – IT Specialty - Major Incident Commander**

**Location – Remote - Partial Travel**

The Major Incident Manager (MIM) for a Healthcare IT Enterprise Operations Center (EOC) is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the end-to-end management of critical IT service disruptions that affect patient care, clinical workflows, and hospital operations. This is senior level, decision authority role within Core Tech, responsible for leading enterprise-level, Tier 1 incidents across the healthcare environment. This role goes beyond traditional incident coordination and requires command authority, strong executive communication, and deep understanding of healthcare IT operations, including infrastructure, networking, clinical imaging, and EHR access. This role exists because the current incident model is not meeting enterprise needs and requires experienced leadership to reset and stabilize Tier 1 incident response across multiple facilities.

This role is accountable for incident outcomes, not coordination alone. Candidates should be vetted for sound judgement, executive level communication and styles, and ability to lead people.

**Role Summary**

The Major Incident Manager acts as the "Incident Commander," (single point of command) driving the swift restoration of critical healthcare services (e.g., EHR access, diagnostic imaging, and network connectivity) while maintaining transparent communication with executive leadership and clinical stakeholders. This role is responsible for incident outcomes, not just processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident Command & Coordination:**

* Lead the Major Incident Bridge by facilitating 24/7 technical bridge calls and "war rooms" to triage and resolve Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) incidents impacting multiple health ministries or systems.
* MIM impact to multiple facilities, wider user impacts, or multiple technology failures.
* Lead real‑time decision‑making under pressure, balancing technical recovery with patient‑safety and clinical impact.
* Resources will not typically be responsible for concurrent major incident ownership

**Clinical Impact Assessment:**

* Quickly evaluate the scope of technical outages to determine their impact on patient safety and critical business applications.
* Outages may impact EHR systems, Clinical Imaging, Network dependencies, as examples.
* Identify trends, anomalies, and recurring failure patterns

**Stakeholder Communication:**

* Issue regular, clear updates to senior leadership (CIO/CTO) and Service Portfolio leads using pre-defined communication templates and protocols.
* Maintain confidence and calm in high‑pressure situations with senior leaders and clinical partners.

**Post-Incident Management:**

* Own and facilitate after action reports and Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) within 48 hours to identify root causes and drive preventive actions.
* Conduct root cause discussions and ensure corrective actions are identified and tracked.
* Communication and stakeholder management are the number‑one success factor for this role and is treated as top priority for candidate review.

**Process Improvement:**

* Own and continuously optimize the enterprise incident management process in alignment with ITIL best practices and healthcare regulatory requirements.

**Vendor & Matrix Management:**

* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal cross-functional teams (Network, Security, Clinical Apps) to ensure rapid service recovery.

**Monitoring and Alerting:**

* Utilize AIOps, triaging and monitoring tools, dashboards, and alerting systems across on-premise and cloud environments (e.g. SolarWinds, NetPath, ScienceLogic) to assist with MTTD and MTTR.

**Incident Response:**

* Serve as an escalation point for complex operational incidents, guiding technical teams to swift and effective resolution for critical monitoring issues.

**Performance Optimization:**

* Analyze monitoring data and performance metrics (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR, Incident Recurrence Rate, SLA Compliance) to identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues, providing recommendations for improvement and capacity planning.

**Automation:**

* Identify and implement automation opportunities for major incident management and routine tasks to reduce manual workload and improve efficiency.

**Collaboration and Documentation:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Application, Network, Security, Cloud Enablement, Managed Service Provider, etc.) to maintain Major Incident Management comprehensive documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks.

**Problem Management:**

* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews to prevent recurring issues and drive long-term solutions.

**Compliance and Security:**

* Ensure MIB processes comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC, HIPAA).

**Qualifications and Skills**

* 8+ years of progressive IT operations or enterprise support experience.
* 5-7+ years in IT major incident management or IT service management, with specific experience in healthcare environments and enterprise operations centers.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, 5-7 years of technical experience in one or more of the following areas - Networking, Clinical Imaging devices and applications and EHR access fundamentals. Infrastructure experience is non-negotiable; candidates that worked MIMs without background in infrastructure will not be a fit. For example: prior Epic‑only or application‑only backgrounds without infrastructure experience will not meet requirements.
* Strong understanding of HIPAA and HITECH compliance regarding protected health information (PHI).
* Proven track record in managing large-scale, network or operations center with complex operations.
* In-depth knowledge of enterprise network architecture, data center operations, cloud environments, and relevant software/tools (e.g., ScienceLogic, Solar/Winds, SendWordNow, ServiceNow).

Soft skills are the first priority in candidate review-

* Excellent crisis leadership and decision-making abilities under pressure.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and performance metrics to drive strategic decisions.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, capable of effective collaboration with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with a focus on details and time management.

**Education and Certifications:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required; an MBA or a related Master's degree is highly preferred.
* Preferred Qualifications and Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience with industry-standard monitoring and observability tools (e.g., ScienceLogic, SolarWinds).

**Work Environment**

* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* May require off-hours work or participation in an on-call rotation to support operations.
* Travel requirements may include quarterly onsite business meetings and occasional travel abroad for vendor relationship management.
* This role often operates in a dynamic, fast-paced, remote operations center and may require working irregular hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to help manage critical incidents and service delivery escalations.

**Top 3 Priorities for this role:**

1. Stakeholder Communication and personality fit
2. Technical Depth (infrastructure centric)
3. Relevant Senior Level Leadership Experience – not just years of experience but depth of what candidate has actually done in career

**Interview process – panel, 2 rounds**

**Round 1:**
Fit, personality, communication, leadership presence (Priority #1)

**Round 2:**
Technical and experiential depth (Priorities #2 and #3)

**Comments for Suppliers:**
A key concern is that candidates have flexibility in hours that they are available to work - the most common shift will be 2 pm to 10 pm Central time. Flexibility in working hours will be an advantage and such candidates will be preferred. Please include candidate availability in the supplier comments section of candidate submittal, as well as on top of resume.

This position requires the frequent and repetitive use of a computer, keyboard, and mouse. Hand and finger dexterity is required.

EMS Bridge extends low-barrier MAT to paramedics, bringing EMS-initiated buprenorphine to communities across the country, including in California. The National Expansion Project builds capacity for emergency department-based MAT across the country; the ED Syphilis/HIV/HCV Screening Program supports emergency departments in implementing routine opt-out screening and linkage to care; and Access Bridge increases access to contraception and treatment for pregnancy emergencies from the ED.

Save the Children has worked in Myanmar since 1995 and is one of the largest international non-governmental organizations operating in the country. Through humanitarian and development programmes, Save the Children supports children and communities across complex and challenging operating environments, using a range of delivery modalities and partnership approaches.
  
As Myanmar's humanitarian, political and funding landscape continues to evolve, Save the Children is adapting its strategies, partnerships and ways of working to protect children's rights, sustain essential services and maximize impact.
  
The Director of Impact and Influence will play a pivotal role in shaping the future direction of the Myanmar Country Office, bringing together technical excellence, evidence, innovation, strategic partnerships, resource mobilisation and advocacy to build an impactful, adaptive and sustainable programme portfolio.
  
The position offers significant opportunities for strategic leadership, organizational transformation and external engagement, working alongside experienced national and international teams and partners committed to achieving lasting results for children.
  
ROLE PURPOSE
  
The Director of Impact and Influence is a senior strategic leader and member of the Country Office Senior Management Team, responsible for driving Save the Children's impact, influence and sustainable programme development in Myanmar.
  
Reporting to the Country Director, the postholder provides strategic leadership across Programme Development and Quality (PDQ), Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (RMEAL), New Business Development (NBD), Technical Excellence, and Advocacy, Campaigns, Communications and Media (ACCM).
  
The Director ensures these functions work together to deliver measurable outcomes for children, strengthen organizational positioning, advance strategic partnerships and support the achievement of the Country Strategic Plan.

This includes strengthening locally led approaches, promoting innovation, diversifying financing and partnerships, and ensuring programme investments respond to evolving needs, risks and opportunities.
  
The Director leads and coordinates the development, implementation, performance monitoring and periodic review of the Country Strategic Plan and Country Office Impact Model, ensuring evidence and learning inform strategic choices, programme adaptation, resource allocation and influencing priorities.
  
Working closely with the Director of Programme Operations and other SMT members, the Director ensures that strategic ambition is translated into operationally feasible, accountable and effective programming.
  
As a member of the SMT, the postholder shares collective responsibility for organizational leadership, strategic direction, risk management, safeguarding, financial sustainability, staff wellbeing and achievement of Country Office objectives.

**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the Kingdom. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

The Director of Commercial Shared Services leads the shared commercial capabilities that support Arabic AI Agents & Services verticals. The role is responsible for ensuring the effective integration and performance of Sales Development Representatives (SDR), Bidding, and Sales Operations, establishing consistent processes, governance, reporting, and service standards across the commercial pipeline. Working closely with the COO and the Heads of AI & Agents and Services, the Director translates commercial priorities into coordinated lead-generation, bid-management, and operational-support activities; improves pipeline visibility and execution; and enables the commercial teams to pursue opportunities efficiently, consistently, and in line with company objectives.

### **Shared Commercial Strategy & Governance**

* Translate the Commercial priorities into an integrated operating plan for SDR, Bidding, and Sales Operations, supporting both the AI & Agents and Services verticals.
* Establish shared commercial processes, standards, service levels, and ways of working that promote consistency while accommodating the distinct requirements of each vertical.
* Define clear ownership, handover points, and escalation routes across lead generation, opportunity qualification, bid/no-bid decisions, proposal development, CRM administration, and commercial reporting.

### **Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Heads and Managers within the shared commercial functions, setting clear expectations, priorities, and accountability.
* Agree function-level objectives and KPIs, review performance regularly, address gaps, and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Plan and allocate resources across SDR, Bidding, and Sales Operations according to agreed commercial priorities, workload, deadlines, and business needs.
* Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and a results-oriented culture across the shared services teams.

* Oversee the SDR function’s lead-generation and prospecting plans, ensuring targeting, qualification criteria, outreach activity, and meeting generation align with the priorities of both commercial verticals.
* Define and oversee the SDR strategy, including lead-generation approaches, target-account prioritization, prospecting channels, and outreach strategies, ensuring alignment with the commercial and go-to-market objectives of both verticals.
* Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and automation within SDR activities to enhance lead identification, research, qualification, outreach personalization, and follow-ups, while automating routine tasks such as CRM updates, lead enrichment, and reporting to improve productivity, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure effective lead handover and feedback loops between SDR and the relevant AI & Agents or Services business development and account management teams.
* Review lead-generation and pipeline-contribution results with the Head of SDR, using data and market feedback to improve lead quality, conversion, and productivity, and continuously optimize SDR strategies, processes, AI utilization, and automation effectiveness against relevant performance KPIs.

* Ensure bids and proposals are coordinated with the relevant vertical and subject-matter teams, are responsive to client requirements, and meet quality, compliance, commercial, and submission-deadline requirements.
* Position the Bidding function as a strategic business partner by engaging relevant functions, including Business Development, Presales, Product, Engineering, Production, Finance, Legal, and Marketing, early in the bid lifecycle to jointly shape opportunities, develop competitive proposals, and maximize win probability.
* Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and automation across the bidding lifecycle to improve opportunity assessment, RFP analysis, requirement mapping, proposal development, and content reuse, enhancing efficiency, quality, and scalability while maintaining appropriate accuracy and compliance controls.
* Monitor bid pipeline, submission schedules, win/loss outcomes, and lessons learned; use insights to strengthen bid strategy and proposal effectiveness.
* Escalate material bid risks, resource constraints, pricing or margin considerations, and approval requirements to the appropriate decision-makers.

* Provide the COO and commercial leadership with timely analysis of pipeline health, lead conversion, bid performance, workload, and other relevant commercial KPIs.
* Develop and maintain a centralized Commercial Hub that supports both AI & Agents and Services while ensuring clear differentiation in their market positioning, value propositions, offerings, and commercial messaging.
* Oversee the maintenance of sales enablement materials, proposal and presentation templates, commercial collateral, and relevant records and workflows, ensuring the development of tailored presentations, sales decks, and marketing collateral that reflect the distinct value propositions and commercial priorities of each vertical while maintaining consistent corporate branding.
* Drive the effective use and continuous improvement of CRM platforms and other commercial tools, coordinating adoption, user guidance, and process changes as needed.
* Ensure the Commercial Hub operates as a strategic enabler for both verticals by facilitating access to commercial resources, standardizing best practices, and supporting the development and continuous improvement of sales enablement materials and tools.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with the Heads of AI & Agents and Services to understand their priorities, coordinate shared-function support, and resolve competing demands transparently.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, Marketing, Production, Technology, Products and other relevant teams to support forecasting, budgeting, proposal development, contract coordination, and compliant commercial execution.
* Maintain clear communication with stakeholders on priorities, capacity, deadlines, risks, performance, and required decisions.
* Ensure shared services support both verticals fairly and effectively, with priorities and resource allocation based on agreed business needs.

### **Process Improvement, Risk & Compliance**

* Document, maintain, and improve shared commercial workflows, policies, procedures, templates, and controls.
* Identify bottlenecks, duplication, data gaps, and operational risks across the commercial process, and implement improvements that increase efficiency and quality.
* Ensure activities within the shared commercial functions comply with company policies, approval authorities, contractual requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Promote the use of performance data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to continuously improve service quality and commercial outcomes.
* Carry out other duties necessary for the effective operation of the department.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Education, Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field; a relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* 12-15 years of relevant experience across commercial operations, sales operations, bidding/proposal management, sales development, or related commercial functions, including substantial leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple teams or functions, setting performance expectations, and improving processes and operational effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of commercial pipelines, lead generation and qualification, bid management, CRM governance, sales reporting, and forecasting support.
* Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, sales analytics and reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Familiarity with SDR, lead-generation, and bidding/proposal management platforms is an advantage.
* Experience in technology solutions and product companies is an advantage; experience in AI companies is a strong advantage.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

The successful candidate will lead creative consultancy, develop bespoke commissions, advise clients on art and design acquisitions, and actively generate sales opportunities for existing artworks and design products.

This is a senior, client-facing position requiring the ability to translate creative requirements into commercially viable proposals, identify appropriate artists and designers, and manage commissions from initial enquiry through to final delivery.

A central responsibility will be developing and commercialising Tasmeem Tashkeel's portfolio of available artworks and design products, working closely with the Gallery Manager to identify suitable works from Tashkeel's artist and designer community and proactively present them to private collectors, corporate clients, hospitality groups, developers and retailers.

The consultant will work with the Sales Manager and Business Development Manager to convert client opportunities into confirmed commissions while independently identifying potential clients, developing relationships and generating additional revenue.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Art & Design Consultancy**

* Lead client consultations, assess creative requirements and develop original art and design concepts aligned with project objectives, budgets and intended environments.
* Provide consultancy across bespoke artworks, public art, furniture, lighting, product design, interior and spatial interventions, corporate and VIP gifting, exhibitions and creative installations.
* Research, recommend and present suitable artists, designers, artworks, materials and creative approaches.
* Prepare creative briefs, concept proposals, mood boards, artwork selections and professional presentations.
* Advise on aesthetics, materials, functionality, cultural relevance, sustainability and production feasibility.
* Maintain awareness of contemporary art and design practices, regional creative talent, market developments and collecting trends.

**2. Art Sales, Acquisitions & Client Development**

* Actively promote and sell existing artworks, limited-edition pieces, collectible design objects and products represented or made available through Tashkeel.
* Proactively approach private collectors, corporate buyers, property developers, hospitality groups, architects, interior designers and retailers with curated artwork and design selections, including where no prior commission enquiry exists.
* Develop tailored artwork and design proposals for specific clients, spaces, collections and commercial environments.
* Identify opportunities for artwork placement in hotels, offices, residences, public-facing spaces and commercial developments.
* Advise clients on artwork selection, acquisition, pricing, suitability, presentation and installation requirements.
* Develop relationships with new collectors and buyers while maintaining existing client relationships to encourage repeat purchases and commissions.
* Identify opportunities to sell existing works, commission new pieces or adapt available designs to meet specific client requirements.
* Work with the Sales Manager and Business Development Manager to establish sales priorities, develop qualified leads and convert opportunities into confirmed sales.
* Contribute to individual revenue targets through direct artwork sales, design product sales and commissioned projects.

**3. Artist & Designer Portfolio Development**

* Work closely with the Gallery Manager to identify commercially relevant artworks and design products from Tashkeel's creative community, including Tanween alumni, mentorship participants, members and resident studio practitioners.
* Build and maintain a diverse portfolio of emerging, mid-career and established artists and designers suitable for private, corporate, institutional and retail clients.
* Evaluate the suitability of individual artists, designers and available works for different B2B and B2C markets.
* Recommend artists and designers for bespoke commissions based on their creative practice, technical capabilities, experience and client requirements.
* Identify opportunities to develop new products, limited editions, exclusive collections and bespoke commissions with artists and designers.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with artists and designers and act as the primary contact for commissioned work.
* Engage artists and designers who have previously worked with Tashkeel. Any engagement with a new artist or designer requires prior approval from the Director.
* Collaborate with the Gallery Manager to ensure that artwork availability, artist agreements, pricing and commercial arrangements are established before presenting works for sale.

**4. Artlogic, Artwork Inventory & Online Sales**

* Work with the Gallery Manager to develop and maintain a comprehensive digital library of artworks, collectible design objects and available products using Artlogic.
* Ensure artwork records include relevant artist information, titles, dimensions, materials, editions, availability, pricing, ownership, images and supporting documentation.
* Organise artworks and products by category, discipline, material, price range and suitability for different client sectors.
* Develop curated selections that can be efficiently presented to collectors, architects, interior designers, corporate clients and retailers.
* Regularly review the inventory to identify available works that can be actively promoted and sold.
* Collaborate with the Gallery Manager and Sales Team to explore digital sales channels, including the potential introduction of Artsy and other relevant platforms.
* Support the development of online sales processes, artwork presentation standards, pricing structures and inventory management procedures.
* Monitor artwork and design product sales performance and recommend opportunities to improve visibility, placement and revenue.

**5. Bespoke Commissions & Project Delivery**

* Manage the creative and client-facing aspects of commissions from initial enquiry and concept development through to final delivery.
* Develop project briefs, creative proposals, artist recommendations and client presentations.
* Coordinate with commissioned artists and designers to establish design requirements, specifications, timelines and deliverables.
* Work with the Project Manager, Design Teams and Manufacturing Team to assess technical feasibility, production methods, materials and installation requirements.
* Maintain oversight of the approved creative direction and ensure the artistic and design intent is preserved during production.
* Ensure the Project Manager and Production Team take responsibility for technical coordination, manufacturing, fabrication and installation when required.
* Monitor project progress, coordinate client approvals and address creative issues that arise during development or production.
* Attend client meetings, site visits and installations within the UAE, with international travel when required for overseas commissions.
* Maintain responsibility for the client relationship, creative quality and successful handover of commissioned work.

**6. Commercial Pricing, Sales & Profitability**

* Work with the Accounts Team to establish accurate cost estimates for artworks, design products and commissioned projects.
* Advise on artist and designer fees, material costs, production expenses, fabrication, logistics and installation requirements.
* Recommend appropriate selling prices, markups and profit margins based on project complexity, market positioning and commercial viability.
* Understand pricing structures for direct sales, wholesale, retail, consignment, artist commissions and bespoke production.
* Assess retailer margins and sales arrangements to ensure that products remain commercially viable for Tashkeel and its creative partners.
* Collaborate with the Sales Manager and Accounts Team on quotations, commercial proposals and negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to increase revenue through artwork acquisitions, additional commissions, complementary products, bespoke adaptations and repeat business.
* Work towards agreed revenue and profitability targets while maintaining the quality and integrity of Tasmeem Tashkeel's creative services.

* Recommend new creative services, consultancy packages, product categories and partnerships that support sustainable revenue growth.
* Collaborate with the Gallery Manager to develop opportunities for artist representation, artwork placement and collectible design sales.
* Support the positioning of Tasmeem Tashkeel as a comprehensive art and design consultancy capable of managing creative projects from concept through to manufacturing and installation.

Work closely with the following departments to ensure effective creative development, commercial coordination and project delivery:

* Sales Manager and Business Development Manager — client acquisition, commercial opportunities, sales targets and strategic growth.
* Gallery Manager — artist relationships, artwork selection, portfolio development, inventory management and artwork sales.
* Art and Design Teams — concept development, creative research and design execution.
* Graphic Design & Branding Team — creative presentations, visual communication and relevant design commissions.

* Marketing Manager — promotion of artworks, designers, commissioned projects and commercial opportunities.
* Accounts Team — costing, quotations, pricing, margins, profitability and sales reporting.

* Revenue generated from commissioned projects, artwork sales and design products.
* Project profitability and anticipated revenue from active opportunities.
